56a35e91966a.title: Hankyoreh Human and Digital Forum to explore future of work and learning in AI era

## Hankyoreh Human and Digital Forum: The Future of Work and Learning in the AI Era

Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the world very quickly. It is changing the way people work, study, and live. To discuss these important changes, the Hankyoreh newspaper is organizing a special event called the **Human and Digital Forum**.

### What Is the Forum About?

The forum will explore how AI is shaping the future of work and education. Experts, business leaders, and thinkers will come together to share their ideas and discuss the challenges that AI brings to society.

Some of the big questions they will ask include:
- Will AI take away people's jobs?
- How should schools change the way they teach?
- What new skills will workers need in the future?
- How can humans and AI work together in a positive way?

### Why Is This Topic Important?

AI tools are already being used in many industries. For example, AI can write reports, create images, answer customer questions, and even help doctors diagnose diseases. Because of this, many people are worried about their future careers.

At the same time, AI also creates new opportunities. New types of jobs are appearing that did not exist before. Workers who learn how to use AI tools may have a big advantage in the job market.

Education is also changing. Students today need to learn not just facts, but also how to think critically and solve problems — skills that are harder for AI to replace.

### The Role of Forums Like This

Events like the Hankyoreh Human and Digital Forum are important because they bring people together to talk about the future. When experts share research and ideas openly, governments, companies, and schools can make better decisions.

The Hankyoreh is one of South Korea's leading newspapers, known for covering social and political issues in depth. By hosting this forum, it is helping Korean society prepare for the challenges and opportunities of the AI era.

### Looking Ahead

The AI era is not something that will happen in the far future — it is already here. How societies respond to AI today will shape what life looks like for the next generation.

Forums like this one remind us that technology is a tool made by humans, and humans must decide how to use it wisely. The conversation about AI and the future of work and learning is one of the most important conversations of our time.

keyVocab.example: Artificial intelligence is being used in many industries to make work faster and more efficient.

Students need to think critically about the information they find online.

f29f140bbfe1.learnerContent:
## Shinsegae Chief Apologizes Over Starbucks Korea Controversy Linked to Gwangju Massacre

The head of Shinsegae Group, one of South Korea's largest retail conglomerates, has issued a public apology following a controversy involving Starbucks Korea and the May 18th Gwangju Democratic Uprising — one of the most painful and significant events in modern Korean history.

### What Happened?

Starbucks Korea, which operates under the Shinsegae subsidiary E-Mart, became the center of a public backlash after certain content or actions by the company were interpreted by some people as mocking the victims of the 1980 Gwangju massacre. The exact details of the incident sparked heated debate online and in the media, leading to widespread public criticism.

In response, the chairman of Shinsegae stepped forward and offered a formal, public apology. The apology was seen as necessary given the deep emotional and historical significance of the Gwangju uprising to the Korean public.

### What Did the Internal Investigation Find?

Despite the public outrage, an internal investigation conducted by the company concluded that there was **no deliberate intent** to mock or disrespect the victims of the Gwangju massacre. According to the findings, the controversy appeared to stem from carelessness or a lack of sensitivity, rather than a planned effort to demean the memory of those who died.

However, many critics argued that intent alone does not excuse the harm caused. Even unintentional actions can be deeply hurtful when they relate to a historical tragedy as serious as the Gwangju uprising.

### Why Is the Gwangju Massacre So Significant?

The May 18th Democratic Uprising of 1980, often referred to as the Gwangju massacre, was a pro-democracy movement in the city of Gwangju, South Korea. The military government at the time violently suppressed the uprising, resulting in the deaths of hundreds of civilians — though the exact number remains disputed.

The event is remembered as a symbol of resistance against authoritarian rule and a turning point in South Korea's path toward democracy. It remains an extremely sensitive topic, and any perceived disrespect toward its victims is likely to provoke strong public reaction.

### Public Reaction

Many South Koreans expressed anger and disappointment over the incident, especially given that major corporations are expected to be mindful of historical and cultural sensitivities. Some accepted the apology and the findings of the internal probe, while others remained unconvinced, calling for greater accountability.

The controversy highlights the ongoing importance of historical awareness in corporate communications and marketing, particularly in a society where the wounds of the past remain deeply felt.

The investigation found no deliberate attempt to offend anyone with the campaign.

Citizens demanded accountability from the corporation after the harmful mistake was made.

7e43d7bf41e1.learnerContent:
## U.S. Military Quietly Helps Ships Through the Strait of Hormuz

The United States military has been secretly helping commercial ships travel safely through one of the world's most important waterways. According to a U.S. official, the U.S. Central Command has guided around 70 ships through the Strait of Hormuz over the last three weeks.

**What is the Strait of Hormuz?**

The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow body of water located between Iran and Oman in the Middle East. It connects the Persian Gulf to the Arabian Sea. This strait is extremely important because about 20% of the world's oil supply passes through it every day. If ships cannot travel safely through this waterway, global energy prices could rise quickly and affect economies around the world.

**Why Is Military Help Needed?**

The region around the Strait of Hormuz has historically been a place of tension. Iran controls much of the land beside the strait and has, in the past, threatened to block or disrupt shipping in the area. Because of these risks, commercial shipping companies are sometimes worried about sending their vessels through without protection.

The U.S. Central Command is the part of the American military responsible for operations in the Middle East and surrounding regions. By quietly guiding ships through the strait, the military is helping to keep trade flowing and prevent any dangerous incidents.

**What Does "Quietly Guiding" Mean?**

The word "quietly" is important here. The U.S. military has not made loud public announcements about this operation. Instead, it has been working in the background, coordinating with commercial ships to help them pass through safely. This kind of low-profile approach is sometimes used to avoid making political tensions worse while still protecting important trade routes.

**Why Does This Matter for Business?**

The Strait of Hormuz is sometimes called the world's most important oil chokepoint. A "chokepoint" is a narrow passage that controls the flow of something — in this case, oil and natural gas. Countries that import large amounts of energy, including Japan, South Korea, China, and many European nations, depend on shipments that pass through this strait.

If shipping through the strait is disrupted, it can cause oil prices to rise around the world. Higher oil prices affect not just drivers at gas stations, but also airlines, manufacturers, and many other industries. This is why the U.S. military considers keeping the strait open to be a matter of both national security and global economic stability.

**Looking Ahead**

It is not yet clear how long the U.S. military will continue this escort operation, or whether the situation in the region will become more or less tense in the coming weeks. However, the fact that around 70 ships have already been guided through the strait shows that the operation is already significant in scale.

For businesses that rely on global supply chains, news like this is an important reminder of how closely connected international trade and geopolitics can be.

4c151bd6ab92.summary: 뉴욕시에서 새로운 전기 비행기가 시험 비행에 성공했습니다. 이 비행기는 배터리만으로 날 수 있으며, 미래의 친환경 항공 여행 가능성을 보여주고 있습니다.

## Is This the Future of Air Travel? A New Electric Airplane Takes Off in New York

A brand new kind of airplane made its first test flight in New York City recently. This airplane is special because it runs completely on electricity. It does not use jet fuel like most airplanes today.

**What Is an All-Electric Aircraft?**

Most airplanes today burn a type of fuel called jet fuel or kerosene. This creates a lot of pollution and releases carbon dioxide into the air. An all-electric aircraft, on the other hand, uses batteries to power its engines — similar to how an electric car works.

Because it does not burn fuel, an electric airplane produces much less pollution. This is very important because the aviation industry — meaning all the airlines and flights around the world — is responsible for a large amount of greenhouse gas emissions every year.

**The Test Flight in New York**

The new electric aircraft recently completed a test flight in New York City. A test flight is when engineers and pilots fly a new airplane for the first time to see if it works correctly and safely. This kind of flight is a very important step before an airplane can carry passengers.

NYT transportation reporter Niraj Chokshi covered the story and explained what people should know about this new technology.

**Why Is This Exciting?**

Electric airplanes could change the way we travel in the future. Here are some reasons why people are excited about this technology:

- **Less pollution:** Electric planes do not burn fossil fuels, so they are much better for the environment.
- **Lower costs:** Electricity can be cheaper than jet fuel, which could mean lower ticket prices for passengers in the future.
- **Less noise:** Electric engines are often much quieter than traditional jet engines. This is good news for people who live near airports.

**What Are the Challenges?**

However, there are also some big challenges. Today's batteries are heavy and cannot store as much energy as jet fuel. This means that current electric airplanes can only fly short distances. Flying long distances — for example, across the ocean — is not yet possible with electric power alone.

Engineers and scientists are working hard to improve battery technology. Many experts believe that electric airplanes will first be used for short trips between nearby cities, sometimes called "regional flights."

**What Does the Future Look Like?**

Several companies around the world are developing electric aircraft. Some are also working on hybrid airplanes, which use both electricity and fuel. The goal is to make air travel cleaner and more sustainable.

The test flight in New York City is an exciting step forward. While we may not see electric airplanes carrying hundreds of passengers on long trips very soon, the technology is moving fast. The future of cleaner air travel may be closer than we think.

## Apple's Smart Glasses Strategy: Bigger Than You Think

Apple is planning to enter the smart glasses market, but its ambitions go far beyond competing with tech companies. According to Bloomberg journalist Mark Gurman, Apple wants to change the entire eyewear industry — not just the smart glasses segment.

### Learning from the Apple Watch

To understand Apple's plan, it helps to look at what happened with the Apple Watch. When it launched, Apple was not only competing against other smartwatches like Pebble and Motorola. It was also targeting traditional watch brands such as Swatch, Fossil, and Seiko. Apple wanted to replace the everyday watch that millions of people already wore.

That strategy worked extremely well. Today, the Apple Watch generates an estimated **$17 billion** every year. It became one of the best-selling watches in the world, not just the best-selling smartwatch.

### The Same Plan for Smart Glasses

Now, Apple appears to be using the same approach for smart glasses. Yes, it will compete against tech rivals like **Meta** (which makes the Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses) and **Samsung**. But Apple is also looking at traditional eyewear brands like **Oakley**, **Ray-Ban**, and **Warby Parker**.

These brands sell glasses in the **$200 to $500 price range** — exactly where Apple is expected to position its smart glasses. This means Apple is not just trying to win the smart glasses race. It wants to become the brand people choose when they buy any pair of glasses.

### Why Eyewear Is a Big Opportunity

The global watch market is worth an estimated **$132 billion**. That already sounds like a lot of money. But the global eyewear market is even larger. Billions of people around the world wear glasses or sunglasses every day, which makes it a potentially huge opportunity for Apple.

Unlike a watch, which is optional, many people need glasses to see clearly. This means the customer base is enormous. If Apple can make smart glasses that look stylish, feel comfortable, and work seamlessly with iPhones, it could attract both tech enthusiasts and everyday glasses wearers.

### What Could Apple's Smart Glasses Do?

Details about the product are still limited. However, analysts expect Apple's smart glasses to include features like health tracking, audio, and possibly a camera or augmented reality (AR) display. Apple has been developing AR technology for years, so the glasses could eventually show digital information on top of the real world.

### A Long Game

Apple is known for entering markets slowly and carefully. It often waits until the technology is ready and the product feels truly polished. The smart glasses market is still young, and many early products have struggled to attract mainstream buyers. But if any company can bring smart glasses to a wide audience, Apple — with its design skills, loyal customers, and massive retail presence — is well positioned to try.

Just as the Apple Watch made many people reconsider wearing a traditional watch, Apple's smart glasses could one day make people reconsider what a pair of glasses can do.

## How to Watch Nvidia's Computex Keynote — And What to Expect

Nvidia CEO **Jensen Huang** is taking the stage for a major keynote speech at **Computex Taipei**, one of the world's largest technology trade shows. The presentation is scheduled to begin at **8PM PT / 11PM ET**, and you can watch it live online.

### What Is Computex?

Computex is a large technology conference held every year in Taipei, Taiwan. It is one of the most important events in the computer hardware industry. Major companies like Nvidia, AMD, and Intel often use Computex to announce new chips, processors, and other products.

### What Is Nvidia Expected to Announce?

There has been a lot of speculation ahead of this keynote. The biggest rumor is a new **partnership between Nvidia and Microsoft**. This partnership is said to focus on bringing **Windows on ARM** to a wider audience.

ARM is a type of processor design that is known for being energy-efficient. It is the same type of chip used in most smartphones. In recent years, companies have been trying to use ARM chips in laptops and desktop computers as well, because they can offer long battery life and strong performance.

### New Nvidia Chips: N1 and N1X

According to reports, Nvidia is planning to reveal two new ARM-based processors called the **N1** and **N1X**. These chips are expected to power a new generation of **Microsoft Surface** computers that have not yet been officially announced.

Microsoft has been hinting at a "**new era of PC**" for its Surface lineup. Many people believe this refers to computers powered by these new Nvidia ARM chips. If the rumors are correct, it would mark a significant step forward for Windows on ARM.

### A History of Nvidia and Microsoft ARM Collaboration

This is not the first time Nvidia and Microsoft have worked together on ARM-based computers. Back in **2012**, Microsoft launched the **Surface RT**, which used Nvidia's **Tegra ARM CPU**. However, the Surface RT was not a success. It had limited app support and struggled to compete with traditional Windows laptops.

Since then, ARM technology has improved enormously. Apple's M-series chips, which are also based on ARM design, have shown that ARM processors can be extremely powerful. This gives Microsoft and Nvidia a much better chance of success this time around.

### Why Does This Matter?

If Nvidia and Microsoft successfully launch popular ARM-based Windows computers, it could change the PC market significantly. Consumers could get laptops with better battery life and strong performance, while Microsoft could reduce its dependence on Intel chips.

For Nvidia, expanding into PC processors would also be a major new business area, beyond its well-known graphics cards and AI chips.

### How to Watch

You can watch Jensen Huang's full keynote live online at the Nvidia website or through official streams embedded on tech news sites. The presentation is expected to include product announcements, demonstrations, and details about Nvidia's future plans.

2464192a0d54.title: Sadly, the Stars of ‘Heated Rivalry’ Turned Down Actors on Actors — And Here’s Why
2464192a0d54.summary: Variety의 'Actors on Actors' 프로그램 프로듀서가 드라마 '격렬한 라이벌리' 주연 배우들이 출연을 거절한 사실을 처음으로 공개했습니다. 그동안 팬들이 특정 배우 조합이 왜 성사되지 않았는지 궁금해할 때 제작진은 내부 사정을 밝히지 않아 왔습니다. 이번에는 이례적으로 그 이유를 설명하기로 했습니다.
2464192a0d54.learnerContent:
## Why the Stars of 'Heated Rivalry' Said No to Actors on Actors

Variety magazine runs a popular series called **Actors on Actors**. In this series, two actors sit down together and have a deep conversation about their work, their craft, and their experiences in Hollywood. It has been running for many years and is very well-loved by fans of film and television.

The producer of the series recently decided to share something unusual — a behind-the-scenes secret about how the show is put together. For years, this producer stayed quiet about the details of how actor pairings are chosen. When fans complained on social media, asking why two obviously well-matched actors were never paired together, the producer said nothing publicly.

**The process is harder than it looks.**

Choosing which actors will appear together is not simple. The production team thinks carefully about which actors would have interesting things to say to each other. They consider things like the type of roles each actor plays, the kinds of films or shows they have appeared in, and whether their personalities might work well together in conversation.

However, even when the team finds what seems like a perfect match, things do not always work out. Actors can be very busy. They may have scheduling conflicts, meaning they are not available at the same time. Sometimes, an actor's manager or publicist decides the appearance is not the right fit for their client's image or career at that moment. And sometimes, actors simply say no — without giving a detailed reason.

**What happened with 'Heated Rivalry'?**

This time, the producer chose to break the usual silence. The stars of the show *Heated Rivalry* were approached to take part in an Actors on Actors conversation. This was considered a natural choice — the show has been very successful and the performances have received strong praise from critics and audiences.

However, the actors turned down the invitation. The producer felt that this particular situation deserved a public explanation, because many fans had been hoping to see these actors featured in the series. Rather than let fans wonder or feel disappointed without any context, the producer decided to be open about what happened.

This kind of transparency — being honest and open — is not common in the entertainment industry. Studios, managers, and publicists usually prefer to keep these conversations private.

**Why does it matter?**

For fans, knowing the truth can actually be reassuring. It shows that the Variety team did try. It also gives a more realistic picture of how the entertainment industry works. Getting busy, in-demand actors to agree to anything — even a short interview — requires a lot of negotiation and good timing.

The producer's decision to speak up shows a respect for the audience. Fans invest a lot of emotion in the shows and actors they love, and they deserve to understand, at least sometimes, why things happen the way they do behind the scenes.

520a4526ba41.title: ‘Viva Carmen’ Review: The Visuals Do the Singing in a Ravishing Animated Riff on Bizet’s Opera
520a4526ba41.summary: '비바 카르멘(Viva Carmen)'은 비제의 유명 오페라 '카르멘'을 어린이용 애니메이션으로 재해석한 작품입니다. 음악을 전면에 내세우는 대신 이야기와 시각적 요소를 중심으로 구성한 대담한 시도가 돋보입니다. 화려한 영상미가 오페라의 감성을 대신하며 독특한 경험을 선사합니다.
520a4526ba41.learnerContent:
## 'Viva Carmen' Review: A Bold Animated Take on a Classic Opera

**What is 'Viva Carmen'?**

*Viva Carmen* is a new animated film based on *Carmen*, one of the most famous operas in the world. The original *Carmen* was composed by French composer Georges Bizet and first performed in 1875. It tells the story of passionate, dangerous love and jealousy, ending in tragedy and murder. It is a powerful, dramatic work — and a very unlikely choice for a children's film.

Yet that is exactly what the filmmakers have done. They have taken this intense, adult story and reimagined it as an animated movie for younger audiences. It is a bold and somewhat risky creative decision.

**Music takes a back seat.**

In any opera, the music is the heart of the experience. Operas are not primarily about storytelling — they are about how that story is expressed through singing and orchestral music. Bizet's *Carmen* is especially famous for its rich, exciting score, which includes some of the most recognizable melodies in all of classical music.

In *Viva Carmen*, however, the music has been significantly reduced. Instead of placing the singing and orchestral arrangements at the centre of the film, the filmmakers have chosen to focus on the narrative — the actual plot and characters. This is a very unusual approach, and for fans of the original opera, it may feel like a surprising loss.

The reviewer describes this choice as **audacious**, meaning it is daring and confident in a way that could easily go wrong. Removing the music from an opera adaptation is a bit like making a film about a famous painting without showing any colours.

**So what replaces the music?**

The answer, according to the review, is the visuals. The animation in *Viva Carmen* is described as **ravishing** — meaning extraordinarily beautiful and visually stunning. The filmmakers appear to have put enormous creative energy into the look of the film, using rich colours, imaginative designs, and expressive animation to carry the emotional weight that the music would normally provide.

In this way, the film attempts to translate the experience of opera into a visual language. Rather than making you feel something through sound, it tries to move you through what you see on screen.

**A children's film with adult roots.**

Adapting *Carmen* for children brings its own challenges. The original story involves passionate and destructive romantic obsession — what the French call *amour fou*, or "mad love" — as well as violence and death. These themes are clearly not suitable for young children in their original form.

The filmmakers must have made significant changes to soften or reframe the story while still keeping some of its energy and spirit. Whether they have succeeded is part of what the full review explores.

**Final thoughts.**

*Viva Carmen* is clearly not a film for everyone. Fans of Bizet's opera may miss the music deeply. But for audiences open to something experimental and visually inventive, it offers a fresh and unexpected perspective on a 150-year-old classic.

keyVocab.example: It was an audacious decision to rewrite the ending of such a beloved classic story.
The ravishing landscape photography made the documentary a pleasure to watch.
The director decided to adapt the novel into a stage musical.
The film's narrative moves quickly, keeping the audience engaged from start to finish.
The orchestral score added great emotion to the final scene of the film.

## DMX Gets His Own Street in Yonkers

The city of Yonkers, New York, has honored a famous rapper with a very special tribute. A street corner in the city will now carry the name **"Earl DMX Simmons Way."**

### Who Was DMX?

DMX was a popular hip-hop artist. His real name was Earl Simmons. He grew up in Yonkers, a city just north of New York City. DMX became one of the most well-known rappers of the 1990s and 2000s. He was famous for his powerful voice and emotional songs. Some of his most popular albums include *It's Dark and Hell Is Hot* and *Flesh of My Flesh, Blood of My Blood.*

DMX passed away in April 2021 at the age of 50. He died after suffering a heart attack. His death made fans and fellow musicians very sad all around the world.

### The New Street Name

The corner of School Street and Brooke Street in Yonkers will be renamed in his honor. This is the area where DMX spent time growing up. Now, people who walk or drive past that corner will see his name.

Renaming a street after someone is a common way for cities to remember important people. It is a permanent tribute that the community can see every day.

### Why This Matters

For the people of Yonkers, DMX was more than just a famous rapper. He was someone from their community. He represented the city on a world stage. Many local people feel proud that someone from Yonkers became so successful.

Fans of DMX from around the world have celebrated this news. They feel that the street naming is a fitting way to keep his memory alive.

The renaming of the street shows that DMX's impact on music and on his hometown will not be forgotten. His name will now be a permanent part of the streets of Yonkers.

## Doug Shaw, Musician of Highlife and Gang Gang Dance, Dies at 43

Doug Shaw, a respected musician from New York City, has died at the age of 43. He passed away this week after suffering a stroke. Shaw was known for his work with two musical projects: the experimental band **Gang Gang Dance** and his own project called **Highlife.**

### Who Was Doug Shaw?

Doug Shaw was a veteran musician, meaning he had many years of experience in the music world. He was an important figure in New York's underground and experimental music scene. This type of music often pushes boundaries and explores unusual sounds and ideas, rather than following mainstream pop music trends.

Shaw was a member of Gang Gang Dance, a band formed in New York City in the early 2000s. The group became well known for mixing many different styles of music together, including noise, electronica, and world music influences. They built a loyal following among fans of experimental and alternative music.

In addition to his work with Gang Gang Dance, Shaw also worked on a project called Highlife. This allowed him to explore his musical ideas in different ways.

### His Death

Shaw suffered a stroke, which is a serious medical event that happens when blood flow to the brain is suddenly blocked or interrupted. A stroke can cause severe damage to the brain and can be life-threatening. Sadly, Shaw did not recover, and he passed away at the young age of 43.

### Reactions

News of Shaw's death has brought sadness to New York's music community and to fans around the world. Losing a musician at such a young age is always a great loss. Shaw had dedicated much of his life to creating music that was creative and unique.

His contribution to experimental music, especially through Gang Gang Dance, helped shape the sound of New York's alternative music scene in the 2000s and beyond.

### A Lasting Legacy

Although Doug Shaw is gone, the music he created with Gang Gang Dance and Highlife continues to influence other musicians. His willingness to experiment and take creative risks is something that many artists admire.

The music community is remembering him as a talented and dedicated artist who brought something special to the world of experimental music.

## Korean Voters Send a Mixed Message

In South Korea's recent election, voters made their feelings very clear about the ruling People Power Party (PPP). They rejected the PPP strongly, giving the party a significant defeat at the ballot box. However, the results told a more complicated story for the main opposition, the Democratic Party of Korea.

### A Punishment, Not a Reward

Political analysts described the election outcome as a "rebuke" — a strong public criticism — of the PPP rather than a full show of support for the Democrats. In other words, many voters chose the Democratic Party not because they fully trusted it, but because they wanted to send a warning to the government in power.

This kind of voting behavior is sometimes called "protest voting." People vote against a party they dislike instead of voting for a party they truly believe in. It is a common pattern in democratic countries when voters feel frustrated but are not yet convinced by any alternative.

### What Went Wrong for the PPP?

The PPP has faced serious difficulties over the past year. Public trust in the government dropped significantly following political controversies and economic concerns. Many citizens felt that the ruling party was not listening to their needs or addressing important everyday issues such as the cost of living and housing prices.

As a result, voters across different age groups and regions turned away from the PPP in large numbers. The scale of the rejection surprised even some opposition leaders.

### The Democrats' Incomplete Victory

Despite gaining seats and performing well overall, the Democratic Party did not receive what analysts call a "mandate" — a clear and strong public instruction to govern in a particular way. A mandate usually means voters not only rejected the other side but also actively chose and trusted the winning party.

Instead, exit polls and post-election surveys suggested that many Democratic voters still had doubts about the party's leadership and policy direction. Some voters said they wished there were stronger or more trustworthy choices available.

### What Happens Next?

For the PPP, the priority now is rebuilding trust with the public. Party leaders will likely need to change their approach, replace some key figures, and show that they have heard the voters' message.

For the Democratic Party, the challenge is different but equally important. Winning without a full mandate means the party must work harder to prove it deserves the public's confidence. Simply being "not the PPP" will not be enough to maintain voter support in future elections.

### A Divided Electorate

This election reflects a broader trend seen in many democracies around the world: voters are increasingly unhappy with established parties but have not found new leaders or movements they fully trust. South Korean politics remains deeply divided, and neither major party has yet found a way to unite the country behind a shared vision.

The coming months will be critical. How each party responds to this mixed verdict will shape South Korean politics for years to come.

## The Return of Ideological Litmus Tests in South Korea

A troubling pattern has re-emerged in South Korean public life: the practice of judging people not by their actions or arguments, but by whether they pass an ideological "litmus test." This column argues that the return of such thinking — labeling fellow citizens as enemies based on their political beliefs — poses a serious threat to democratic culture.

### What Is an Ideological Litmus Test?

A litmus test, borrowed from chemistry, is a quick way of judging something. In politics, an ideological litmus test means deciding whether a person is acceptable — or even trustworthy — based on whether they hold the "correct" political views. Those who fail the test are not simply seen as people with different opinions; they are branded as enemies, traitors, or threats.

This kind of thinking reduces complex political debate to a simple question: "Are you with us or against us?"

### A History Worth Remembering

South Korea has painful historical experience with ideological labeling. During the Cold War era and periods of authoritarian rule, accusations of being a "communist sympathizer" or a "pro-government collaborator" were used to silence dissent, destroy reputations, and justify political persecution. Many innocent people suffered because of such labels.

For decades, South Korean civil society worked hard to move beyond this binary, accusatory style of politics. The democratic movements of the 1980s and the gradual consolidation of pluralism seemed to promise a more mature political culture — one where disagreement could coexist with mutual respect.

### The Unsettling Return

Recent political discourse suggests that this hard-won progress may be eroding. Across the political spectrum, there are growing signs that opponents are being framed not merely as rivals with different priorities, but as existential enemies who must be defeated and discredited.

Online spaces amplify this tendency dramatically. Social media algorithms reward outrage and tribal loyalty over nuance. Politicians who use inflammatory language attract more attention and donations than those who seek compromise. The incentives, in short, push toward confrontation.

The column's author finds this trend deeply unsettling — not only because it coarsens public debate, but because it creates a chilling effect on free expression. When people fear being labeled and ostracized for their views, they self-censor. Honest conversation becomes impossible.

### Naming the Enemy

The title of this column — "Naming the Enemy" — refers to a specific political tactic: publicly identifying individuals or groups as enemies of the nation, democracy, or the people. This rhetoric, when it becomes normalized, can have dangerous consequences. It legitimizes hostility, erodes empathy, and in extreme cases, has historically preceded violence or repression.

The author is careful to note that identifying genuine threats to democracy is legitimate and necessary. But there is a critical difference between holding power accountable and demonizing ordinary citizens who simply hold different political views.

### A Call for Reflection

Ultimately, this column is a plea for political maturity. South Korea's democracy is relatively young but has achieved remarkable things. Preserving it requires citizens and political leaders alike to resist the temptation to sort everyone into friend or foe.

Democracy depends on the ability to live alongside those we disagree with — and to argue our case without reaching for the language of enmity.

## M&S Starts a New Training Program for Young People

Marks & Spencer (M&S), a famous British shop, has announced a new traineeship program. The program will help 1,000 young people who do not have a job, are not in school, or are not doing any training.

### What Is a Traineeship?

A traineeship is a short program that helps young people learn skills and get work experience. It is different from a regular job. In a traineeship, young people learn while they work. This helps them prepare for a real job in the future.

M&S believes that this kind of program is very important right now. Many young people in the UK are struggling to find work or get into education. This is sometimes called being "NEET" — Not in Employment, Education, or Training.

### Why Is M&S Doing This?

M&S says there is a "growing challenge" with young people who are NEET. This means the problem is getting bigger. More and more young people are finding it hard to start their careers.

By offering 1,000 traineeships, M&S wants to give these young people a chance. The company hopes that after the program, the young people will be more confident and ready to work.

M&S is one of the biggest retailers in the United Kingdom. It sells food, clothes, and home products. The company has many stores across the country, so it has the ability to help young people in many different places.

### Why Does This Matter?

When young people cannot find jobs or get education, it can be very difficult for them. They may lose confidence, and it becomes harder to find work later. Programs like this one from M&S can make a big difference.

Governments and companies often work together to solve this problem. When big companies like M&S offer training programs, it helps young people get the experience they need. This is good for the young people, and it is also good for the companies because they can find new, trained workers.

If you are a young person in the UK who is not working or studying, a traineeship like this could be a great opportunity to start building your future.

## Scott Pelley Speaks Out After Being Fired From CBS News

Scott Pelley, a veteran television journalist, has given his first major interview since being fired from CBS News. He spoke with The New York Times, sharing his thoughts and reflections after a long and distinguished career at one of America's most respected broadcasters.

### A Long Career at CBS

Pelley worked at CBS News for 37 years — more than three and a half decades. During that time, he took on some of the most prestigious roles in American broadcast journalism.

He served as a **White House correspondent**, meaning he reported directly on the President of the United States and the activities of the US government. This is considered one of the most high-profile assignments a television journalist can receive.

He was also a correspondent for **"60 Minutes"**, the long-running CBS news magazine program. "60 Minutes" is famous for its in-depth investigative reports and interviews with world leaders, celebrities, and newsmakers. Working on the program is widely seen as a mark of journalistic achievement.

### The Interview With The New York Times

The New York Times described the interview as Pelley's "first extended interview" since his dismissal from CBS. This suggests that he had largely stayed silent in public following the news of his firing — a notable choice given that he spent his career asking questions and reporting on others.

The interview covered five key takeaways — major points or insights — from the conversation. While the specific details of what Pelley said were not fully outlined in the initial report, interviews of this kind typically address topics such as the circumstances surrounding a departure, reflections on a career, and the state of the journalism industry.

### Why This Story Matters

The firing of a senior journalist from a major news network is always significant. It raises questions about the pressures facing traditional television news in a rapidly changing media landscape. Audiences are increasingly turning to online platforms and social media for news, putting legacy broadcasters like CBS under financial and editorial pressure.

For many journalism professionals and media observers, Pelley's departure is a reminder of the challenges facing experienced reporters in an industry that is undergoing dramatic transformation. His willingness to speak publicly, even in a measured way, may offer insight into tensions within one of America's most iconic news organisations.

Pelley's career stands as a significant chapter in the history of American broadcast journalism, and his interview with The New York Times is likely to attract considerable attention from both media professionals and the general public.

## Remembering Anthony Head: The Heart of Buffy the Vampire Slayer

Sad news came on Friday when the world learned that British actor Anthony Head had passed away at the age of 72. Head was best known for playing Rupert Giles in the popular supernatural TV drama *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*. Fans and former co-stars quickly took to social media to share their grief and to celebrate his extraordinary talent.

### Who Was Anthony Head?

Anthony Head had a long and successful acting career. While many fans remember him most as Giles, he also appeared in many other well-known TV shows and films. He played the powerful king Uther Pendragon in the British fantasy series *Merlin*. He appeared as the Prime Minister in the comedy show *Little Britain*. He also played a creepy headmaster in a memorable episode of *Doctor Who* called "School Reunion." More recently, younger audiences may recognize him as the wealthy and arrogant Rupert Mannion in the hit comedy series *Ted Lasso*.

### The Role He Was Born to Play

Despite his many roles, Giles remained his most iconic and beloved character. Giles was a "Watcher" — a trained expert who guides and protects the vampire slayer, Buffy. In many ways, he was also a father figure to her and the rest of the group of young heroes known as the "Scooby Gang."

Interestingly, there were actually very few episodes of *Buffy* that focused mainly on Giles. However, this does not reflect how important he was to the show. His presence in every scene made the story feel richer and more complete. Head had a special ability to support his fellow actors quietly and skillfully, making every moment better simply by being there. As one way to think about it: if you removed Giles from the show, everything around him would feel smaller and less meaningful.

There was even talk at one point of creating a spin-off series called *Ripper*, which would have followed a younger version of Giles on his own adventures. Unfortunately, the show was never made.

### A Unique Talent

Head was also known for delivering some of the sharpest and most cleverly written lines in the show. Giles often used dry British humor and old-fashioned expressions that made him funny and lovable at the same time.

But his true genius was not just in the big, memorable moments. It was in the small, quiet details — the way he reacted to other characters, the warmth he brought to serious scenes, and the way he helped tell the story even when he was not the center of attention.

### A Legacy That Will Last

Anthony Head leaves behind a rich legacy in television history. *Buffy the Vampire Slayer* ran from 1997 to 2003 and is still considered one of the greatest TV dramas ever made. Giles was a key reason why the show worked so well, and Head's performance is a huge part of why the character is still remembered and loved today.

Fans around the world are sharing their favorite Giles moments online. It is clear that Anthony Head touched the lives of millions of people through his work, and he will be greatly missed.

## Summer Game Fest 2026: The Biggest Stories You Need to Know

Summer Game Fest 2026 has come to an end, and it turned out to be one of the busiest and most surprising gaming events in recent memory. The event lasted almost a full week and featured major announcements from some of the biggest names in the gaming industry.

### What Is Summer Game Fest?

Summer Game Fest is an annual online gaming event where video game companies share news, trailers, and announcements about upcoming games. It usually takes place in June and is watched by millions of gaming fans around the world. Think of it as a kind of "gaming news week," where companies compete for attention and excitement from players.

### A Difficult Time for the Games Industry

This year's event came at a tough time for the games industry. Many companies have been facing challenges, including rising costs and difficult business decisions. For example, some gaming hardware — like consoles — has become more expensive. Also, many so-called "live-service" games, which ask players to keep spending money over time, have been struggling to keep players interested.

Despite these challenges, the big keynote presentations at Summer Game Fest were mostly focused on good news and exciting announcements. Companies appeared to be trying to show strength and confidence, rather than drawing attention to their problems.

### Sony and Microsoft Refocus on What Works

Two of the biggest names in gaming — Sony (maker of PlayStation) and Microsoft (maker of Xbox) — both used their presentations to send a clear message: they are going back to basics.

Both companies announced that they are refocusing on **exclusive games** — titles that can only be played on their own consoles — and **single-player blockbusters**. These are big-budget games with strong stories that players can enjoy on their own, without needing to be connected online or play against others.

This is seen as a return to a more traditional style of gaming, and many fans were happy to hear it. In recent years, both Sony and Microsoft had been experimenting more with online multiplayer and live-service games, with mixed results.

### Everyone Is Avoiding GTA VI

One of the most interesting trends at this year's Summer Game Fest was what companies were *not* doing. It seems that almost every major publisher is trying to avoid releasing their games at the same time as **Grand Theft Auto VI**, the long-awaited next entry in Rockstar Games' hugely popular series.

GTA VI is expected to be one of the biggest game releases in history. Because of this, other companies do not want to compete with it directly. Releasing a game at the same time as GTA VI could mean far fewer people buy it, simply because everyone is focused on Rockstar's title.

### What to Expect Next

Summer Game Fest 2026 showed that the gaming industry is going through a period of change. Companies are rethinking their strategies, focusing on quality single-player experiences, and being very careful about timing their releases.

For players, this could mean some exciting games are on the way — as long as you are willing to wait a little longer for some of them.

## Ariana Grande Opens 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' in Oakland

Pop superstar Ariana Grande has officially kicked off her highly anticipated "Eternal Sunshine Tour" with an opening night show at the Oakland Arena in California. The Saturday night concert left audiences amazed and critics searching for the right words to describe just how impressive the performance was.

### A Night to Remember

The "Eternal Sunshine Tour" takes its name from Grande's most recent studio album, *Eternal Sunshine*, which was released in 2024 and became one of the most celebrated pop albums of that year. The album explored themes of personal growth, healing, and moving forward after difficult times — and the tour brings those ideas to life on stage in a spectacular way.

Reviewers who attended the opening night described the show as a "bravura" performance — a word that means a display of great skill and confidence. Grande performed with incredible energy and precision, reminding everyone in the arena why she is considered one of the biggest pop stars in the world today.

### More Than Just a Singer

Ariana Grande is often described as a "multi-hyphenate" talent, meaning she excels in more than one area of the entertainment industry. In addition to her successful music career, she has worked as an actress, most recently appearing in the blockbuster film *Wicked* (2024), where she played the role of Glinda the Good Witch alongside Cynthia Erivo.

This combination of acting and singing success has made Grande one of the most talked-about entertainers of recent years. Some reviewers at the Oakland show noted that after watching her perform live, they were reminded that her talent as a live performer — her powerful voice, her stage presence, and her emotional connection with the audience — is truly special.

### The Tour Ahead

The Oakland Arena show was just the beginning. The "Eternal Sunshine Tour" is scheduled to continue across North America and potentially other parts of the world in the coming months. Fans who have been waiting to see Grande perform live have described ticket demand as extremely high, with many shows selling out quickly.

The setlist for the opening night featured songs from *Eternal Sunshine* as well as fan favorites from earlier in her career. Grande has built a loyal fanbase — often called "Arianators" — over more than a decade of music, starting with her debut album *Yours Truly* in 2013.

### Why This Tour Matters

For many fans, this tour is a special moment. Grande took a step back from public life for a period of time while filming *Wicked*, and the "Eternal Sunshine Tour" marks her full return to the concert stage. ## Duffy Announces First Live Show in 15 Years

British singer Duffy has announced her first live performance in 15 years. This is big news for music fans who remember her powerful voice and emotional songs from the late 2000s.

### Who Is Duffy?

Duffy is a Welsh singer and songwriter who became famous around 2008. Her hit song "Mercy" reached number one in many countries and won her a Grammy Award. Her debut album, *Rockferry*, was one of the best-selling albums of that year. She was known for her soulful voice, which reminded many listeners of classic artists from the 1960s.

At the height of her fame, Duffy suddenly disappeared from public life. Many fans were confused and worried about her long silence.

### Why Did She Step Away?

In early 2020, Duffy revealed the painful reason for her absence. She shared that she had been abducted, drugged, and assaulted. These traumatic experiences made it impossible for her to continue performing or living a public life. She needed time to heal and recover in private.

Her brave decision to share her story was praised by fans and mental health supporters around the world. She explained that she wanted people to understand why she had disappeared, and she hoped her honesty would help others who had experienced similar trauma.

### A Return to the Stage

Now, after 15 years away from live performance, Duffy is ready to return. The announcement of her upcoming show has created a lot of excitement online. Fans from around the world have expressed their support and happiness for her comeback.

Details about the location and date of the concert have not yet been fully shared, but the announcement alone has been enough to generate huge interest. Many people are hoping this will be the beginning of a longer return to music for the singer.

### Why This Matters

Duffy's story is about more than music. It is about recovery, strength, and finding the courage to face the world again after something terrible happens. Her return to the stage is seen as a symbol of healing.

For music fans, it is also a chance to experience a truly special voice live again. Duffy was considered one of the most talented singers of her generation. After such a long time away, her live show is expected to be an emotional and memorable event.

Whether this concert is a one-time event or the start of something bigger, it is clear that Duffy's return is one of the most talked-about music stories of the year.

115870fff7dc.learnerContent:
## Why the Iran War Didn't Cause the Oil Shock Everyone Expected

When a major conflict involves Iran, many people immediately think about oil. Iran is one of the world's largest oil producers, and it sits near the Strait of Hormuz — one of the most important shipping routes for oil in the world. So when war broke out involving Iran, experts and markets feared a huge rise in oil prices. However, that major "oil shock" never came. Why not?

### What Is an Oil Shock?

An "oil shock" happens when oil prices rise very quickly and dramatically. This usually causes serious problems for the global economy. When oil becomes expensive, the cost of transportation, manufacturing, and everyday goods all go up. People and businesses suffer. Famous oil shocks happened in 1973 and 1979, and they caused recessions in many countries.

### Why People Were Worried This Time

Iran produces millions of barrels of oil every day. It also has significant influence over the Strait of Hormuz, a narrow waterway between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula. About 20% of the world's oil supply passes through this strait. If the strait were blocked or made dangerous, global oil supplies could fall sharply, pushing prices very high.

Because of this, when tensions involving Iran escalated into open conflict, many analysts predicted oil prices would spike dramatically.

### Why the Shock Didn't Happen

Several important factors helped prevent a large oil shock.

First, **global oil supply has diversified significantly** in recent years. The United States became a massive oil producer thanks to shale oil technology. Countries like Guyana and Brazil also increased their output. This means the world is less dependent on Middle Eastern oil than it used to be.

Second, **demand for oil has been weaker than expected**. The global economy has been growing slowly in many regions. Electric vehicles are also becoming more common, which reduces demand for gasoline.

Third, **OPEC+ had extra production capacity ready**. Saudi Arabia and other major producers were able to increase their output quickly to help balance any supply losses caused by the conflict.

Finally, **the Strait of Hormuz remained open**. Despite the fighting, the strait was not fully blocked. Ships continued to move oil through the region, which was critical for keeping supplies stable.

### Market Reactions

Oil prices did rise when the conflict began, and there was a period of uncertainty. However, prices came back down relatively quickly as it became clear that global supplies were not in serious danger. Financial markets also remained calmer than many had predicted.

### What This Tells Us

This situation shows how much the global energy landscape has changed. A conflict that might have caused a catastrophic oil shock twenty or thirty years ago had a much smaller impact today. The world's energy supply is more flexible and more diverse than before.

However, experts warn that this does not mean the Middle East no longer matters for energy security. If a future conflict were to seriously disrupt the Strait of Hormuz for a long period, the consequences could still be very severe. The world got fortunate this time — but the risk has not disappeared entirely.

508b879d0ae5.learnerContent:
## Reclaiming the 'Mandate of Heaven': Xi Jinping and the Era of Great Power Parity

China's President Xi Jinping is reshaping how the world thinks about global power. By drawing on ancient Chinese political philosophy — specifically the concept of the "Mandate of Heaven" — Xi is positioning China not just as a rising power, but as a civilization with a rightful and historic place at the center of world affairs.

### What Is the "Mandate of Heaven"?

The "Mandate of Heaven" (天命, *Tianming*) is a traditional Chinese concept with thousands of years of history. In ancient China, it was the idea that a ruler or dynasty had divine permission to govern — but only as long as they ruled justly and maintained order. If a ruler failed, they were said to have lost the Mandate of Heaven, and it was legitimate for another to take power.

Xi Jinping is not using this concept in a strictly religious sense. Instead, he is using it politically and symbolically to argue that China's rise to global prominence is not an accident or an aggression — it is a restoration of a natural and historical order.

### From a Unipolar to a Multipolar World

Since the end of the Cold War in the early 1990s, the United States has been the world's dominant superpower — a situation often described as a "unipolar" world order. American values, institutions, and military power shaped the rules of international relations.

However, that era appears to be ending. China's extraordinary economic growth over the past four decades has transformed it into the world's second-largest economy. Russia, despite its challenges, continues to project military and geopolitical influence. Regional powers like India, Brazil, and Turkey are also asserting themselves more confidently.

Xi's vision promotes a "multipolar" world — one where several great powers share influence rather than one nation dominating. He frames this not as China seeking to replace the United States, but as a more balanced and equitable global order.

### China's Strategic Positioning

Xi has used several major diplomatic and economic initiatives to build this vision. The Belt and Road Initiative has connected China economically to dozens of countries across Asia, Africa, and Europe. China has also worked to strengthen multilateral bodies where Western influence is weaker, such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and the BRICS grouping.

At the same time, China has been careful to present itself as a defender of the principles of national sovereignty and non-interference — ideas that appeal to many developing nations who feel overlooked or pressured by Western powers.

### How the West Is Responding

The United States and its allies view Xi's ambitions with considerable concern. They argue that China's growing influence comes with conditions, and that Beijing's model of governance — where the Communist Party maintains strict control — poses a challenge to democratic values and institutions globally.

Trade disputes, technology competition, and tensions over Taiwan all reflect the deepening rivalry between China and the West.

### A Turning Point in History?

Many analysts believe we are living through a genuine turning point in world history — a moment when the international order built after World War II and reinforced after the Cold War is being fundamentally renegotiated.

Whether Xi's vision of great power parity leads to a more stable and peaceful world, or to greater competition and conflict, remains one of the most important questions of our time. What is clear is that China under Xi Jinping intends to be far more than a regional power — it aims to be a defining force in shaping the 21st century.

## Jean Ziegler: The Swiss Man Who Challenged His Own Country

Jean Ziegler, a Swiss writer, politician, and activist, died at the age of 92. He was known for being one of Switzerland's most controversial figures — a man who spent his life criticizing the country he called home.

### A Nation with a Perfect Image

Switzerland is famous around the world for its peaceful atmosphere, beautiful mountains, and strong economy. Many people see it as a model of stability and good business practices. Banks, international organizations, and wealthy individuals from across the globe are attracted to Switzerland because of its reputation for safety and neutrality.

However, Jean Ziegler did not accept this perfect image without question. He believed that behind Switzerland's clean and prosperous appearance, there were serious problems that people were not talking about.

### A Gadfly Who Spoke Uncomfortable Truths

The word "gadfly" is used to describe someone who provokes or challenges others, especially powerful people or institutions. Ziegler was exactly this kind of person. He used his voice as a writer and politician to point out what he called the "dark underside" of Swiss society and its role in global affairs.

For example, he criticized Swiss banks for accepting money from corrupt governments and dictators. He argued that Switzerland's financial system helped powerful people hide their wealth, while ordinary people in poorer countries suffered. These were bold and unpopular claims to make in a country that takes great pride in its banking industry.

Ziegler also spoke strongly about world hunger and global inequality. He served as a United Nations Special Rapporteur on the Right to Food from 2000 to 2008. In this role, he reported to the UN about how millions of people around the world did not have enough food to eat, and he blamed wealthy nations and large corporations for making the situation worse.

### Death Threats and Controversy

Because his opinions were so strong and often directed at powerful institutions, Ziegler received death threats during his lifetime. Many of his fellow Swiss citizens were angry at him for damaging the country's reputation. Critics felt he was being unfair or even disloyal to Switzerland.

But Ziegler never stopped speaking out. He believed that true patriotism meant telling the truth about your country, even when it was uncomfortable. He once said that a person who loves their country must also be willing to criticize it.

### A Lasting Legacy

Ziegler wrote many books that were read widely in Europe and beyond. Some of his most well-known works focused on hunger, poverty, and the power of global financial institutions. His writing style was direct and emotional, and he wanted ordinary readers — not just academics — to understand the problems he described.

He was admired by many activists and human rights supporters who shared his belief that the global economic system was unfair to the world's poorest people. At the same time, he remained a deeply divisive figure in Switzerland itself.

Jean Ziegler's life reminds us that speaking the truth, especially when it challenges powerful systems, can be both dangerous and necessary. He died at 92, leaving behind a long record of debate, controversy, and dedication to justice.

## UK and Japan Agree on a Big Investment Deal

The United Kingdom and Japan have made an important agreement. Japan will invest £18 billion — that is 18 billion British pounds — into the UK. This is a very large amount of money, and it is great news for both countries.

### What Will Japan Invest In?

Japanese companies will spend this money in two main areas.

First, they will invest in **UK infrastructure**. Infrastructure means the basic systems that a country needs to work well. This includes things like roads, railways, bridges, and buildings. When a country has good infrastructure, it is easier for people to travel, for businesses to grow, and for the economy to become stronger.

Second, Japanese companies will invest in **offshore wind energy**. "Offshore" means something that is located in the sea, away from the coast. Offshore wind farms use large machines called wind turbines to capture energy from the wind. This energy is then used to make electricity for homes and businesses.

Wind energy is important because it is a **clean energy source**. It does not produce pollution or greenhouse gases like coal or oil. Many countries around the world are trying to use more clean energy to help fight climate change. The UK has some of the best conditions in the world for offshore wind because it is surrounded by sea and has strong winds.

### Who Announced the Deal?

This investment agreement was announced by **Downing Street**, which is the official office and home of the UK Prime Minister. Downing Street is often used to talk about decisions made by the UK government.

### Why Is This Deal Important?

This deal is important for several reasons.

For the **UK**, receiving £18 billion from Japan means more money to build and improve important projects. It can also help create new jobs for people in the UK. Infrastructure projects and wind farms need many workers — engineers, builders, technicians, and more.

For **Japan**, investing in the UK gives Japanese companies the chance to work in a large and stable economy. Japan has many strong companies in areas like technology, energy, and construction. This deal lets them expand their work to Europe.

For the **environment**, more investment in offshore wind means the UK can produce more clean electricity. The UK has a goal to reduce the amount of carbon dioxide it produces by using cleaner sources of energy. Deals like this one help move that goal forward.

### Good Relations Between Two Countries

This agreement also shows that the UK and Japan have a strong and friendly relationship. After the UK left the European Union — an event known as Brexit — the UK government has been working hard to build new trade and investment relationships with countries around the world. Japan is one of the UK's most important partners in Asia.

Both countries hope this deal will be the start of even more cooperation in the future.

## The FBI Built a Fake Town to Train Against Cyberattacks

The FBI has opened a special training facility in Huntsville, Alabama. It is called a **Cyber Range**, and it looks like a small town — but nothing inside it is real. The FBI uses it to practice defending against cyberattacks.

### A Town Built for Training

The facility covers 22,000 square feet, which is about the size of a large warehouse. Inside, there is a convenience store, a gas station, a hospital, and even fully furnished houses. Every building looks realistic, but their real purpose is training.

All the buildings are connected to computer networks, just like in a real town. This means FBI agents and cybersecurity experts can practice responding to attacks on hospitals, power grids, and other important systems.

### Inspired by a Famous Training Site

You may have heard of **Hogan's Alley**, the FBI's famous fake town at Quantico, Virginia. Agents there practice arresting criminals and responding to physical threats. The Cyber Range is similar, but designed for the digital world instead of the physical one.

Cyberattacks are a growing danger. Criminals and foreign governments can attack hospitals, banks, and power companies by breaking into their computer systems. Training facilities like this one help law enforcement learn how to stop such attacks before they cause serious damage.

### A Data Center You Can Hack — On Purpose

One of the most impressive parts of the Cyber Range is its small **data center**. It contains more than 200 servers — computers that store and process data. Trainers can deliberately infect these servers with **malware** (harmful software) or simulate hacking attempts.

This allows agents to experience a real cyberattack in a safe environment. They can make mistakes, learn from them, and improve their skills without putting real systems at risk.

### Why This Matters

Cyberattacks on critical infrastructure — things like power plants, water systems, and hospitals — are becoming more common and more dangerous. In recent years, ransomware attacks have shut down hospitals and disrupted fuel supplies across the United States.

By building a realistic fake town, the FBI can train its people to handle these exact situations. Agents can practice responding to an attack on a fake hospital's computer system, for example, and learn the best ways to limit the damage.

### A Growing Investment in Cybersecurity

The opening of the Cyber Range shows how seriously the U.S. government is taking the threat of digital crime. Investing in training facilities like this one means that law enforcement will be better prepared when real attacks happen.

For cybersecurity professionals, a facility like this is extremely valuable. Hands-on practice in a realistic environment is one of the best ways to build the skills needed to protect people and systems from harm.

## Did China Access a Powerful U.S. AI Model?

A new report suggests that fears over Chinese access to a cutting-edge American AI system partly drove the White House's decision to impose **export restrictions** on the technology. The AI model in question is called **Mythos**, developed by the U.S. artificial intelligence company **Anthropic**.

### What the Report Says

According to a report by the news outlet *Semafor*, a group with links to China may have gained access to Mythos — one of Anthropic's most advanced AI models. This alarming possibility reportedly influenced the White House's decision to restrict who can access or export the model.

Export restrictions on AI models mean that the technology cannot be freely shared with foreign individuals, companies, or governments. Such restrictions are typically used to protect technologies that could give another country a strategic or military advantage.

### Why This Is a National Security Concern

If the Chinese government had access to a model like Mythos 5 or a related system called Fable 5, experts warn it could pose a **serious national security risk**. Advanced AI models can be used for a wide range of purposes — from automating research to developing new weapons or intelligence strategies.

One particular concern is a technique known as **distillation**. In AI development, distillation is a method in which a simpler "student" AI model is trained by learning from a more powerful model. By studying the outputs of a highly advanced model, a distilled version can replicate much of its capability — even without having direct access to the original model's internal code.

This means that even limited access to Mythos could potentially allow a foreign actor to build a nearly equivalent system, undermining the technological advantage the United States currently holds.

### The White House Has Not Confirmed the Report

Despite the seriousness of the claims, the White House has not officially confirmed the *Semafor* report. A post on the social media platform X by David Sacks, an AI and technology advisor to President Trump, did not mention China at all. Sacks instead focused on other justifications for the export restrictions.

This silence leaves many questions unanswered. It is unclear exactly how, or to what extent, any Chinese-linked group may have accessed the model, and whether the access resulted in any actual transfer of sensitive information.

### A Broader Debate Over AI and National Security

This situation reflects a growing tension in the United States over how to handle the rapid development of powerful AI systems. On one hand, companies like Anthropic want their technologies to be widely used and commercially successful. On the other hand, government officials are increasingly worried that advanced AI could be stolen, copied, or exploited by foreign adversaries.

Export controls on AI are still a relatively new and evolving area of policy. As AI models become more powerful, governments around the world are wrestling with difficult questions: Who should be allowed to use these systems? How can access be controlled? And what happens when the technology leaks across borders?

## Timothée Chalamet Loves the Knicks More Than the Oscars

Timothée Chalamet is a very famous actor. He has been in many big movies and has received Oscar nominations. But right now, he is thinking about basketball, not movies.

### A Big Fan of the New York Knicks

Chalamet is a huge fan of the New York Knicks. The Knicks are a professional basketball team. They play their home games at Madison Square Garden in New York City. During the NBA Finals, Chalamet was often seen sitting courtside. "Courtside" means sitting in a seat right next to the basketball court. It is a very special place to watch a game.

### What Did He Say?

The NBA Finals is the most important basketball competition in the United States. The Knicks played in the Finals, and Chalamet was there to support them. After the Knicks won a game, a reporter from SportsCenter asked him how he felt. SportsCenter is a popular sports news TV show.

Chalamet said something very surprising. He said he would "way rather" have a Knicks championship than an Oscar. "Way rather" means he strongly prefers one thing over another. An Oscar is the most famous award in the movie industry. Winning an Oscar is a dream for most actors.

But Chalamet said, "Way rather this than the Oscars! Come on, baby!" He said this with a lot of energy and excitement. It was a very fun moment for sports fans and movie fans alike.

### Why Is This Interesting?

Chalamet is one of the most successful young actors in Hollywood today. He has starred in films like *Dune*, *Call Me by Your Name*, and *Wonka*. He has already been nominated for an Oscar. So for him to say a basketball championship is more important is a big statement.

Of course, he was probably speaking with a lot of emotion in the moment. Sports fans often feel very strongly about their favorite teams. When your team is doing well, it is easy to feel that nothing else matters!

### The Knicks and New York City

The New York Knicks have not won an NBA championship for a very long time. Their last title was in 1973. So if the Knicks win, it would be a very special moment for the whole city of New York. Many fans, including Chalamet, have been waiting a long time for this.

Chalamet grew up in New York City, so the Knicks are his home team. Supporting your home team is a very personal and emotional thing. It connects you to the city and the people you grew up with.

It is clear that Timothée Chalamet is not just an actor — he is also a very passionate basketball fan!

## Alessandro Nivola: Playing Calvin Klein and Talking About a Special Film

Alessandro Nivola is a talented American actor known for his work in both film and television. Recently, he sat down — well, rode in a car — for an interview about his latest TV project and some memories from his past work in film.

### An Interview on the Move

Nivola was not in a quiet studio when he gave the interview. He was traveling along the New Jersey Turnpike, holding his phone vertically as he spoke. He was on his way from New Jersey to New York City to attend the **2026 Gotham TV Awards**. The Gotham Awards celebrate outstanding work in independent film and television.

He had only 25 minutes to spare for the conversation, but he made good use of the time.

### Playing Calvin Klein

Nivola plays **Calvin Klein** in the television drama *Love Story: John F. Kennedy and Carolyn Bessette*. Calvin Klein is one of the most iconic fashion designers in American history. He built a global brand known for its clean, modern style.

The show focuses on the real-life love story between **John F. Kennedy Jr.** — the son of the famous U.S. president — and **Carolyn Bessette**, a publicist who became one of the most photographed women of the 1990s. Their relationship was followed closely by the media, and their story ended in tragedy when both died in a plane crash in 1999.

Calvin Klein was a close friend of Carolyn Bessette in real life, which makes Nivola's role an important one in the story.

### His Co-Star at the Gotham Awards

Nivola mentioned that his co-star **Sarah Pidgeon** received a nomination at the Gotham TV Awards. Pidgeon plays Carolyn Bessette in the series. A nomination at a respected awards ceremony like the Gothams is a strong sign that a performance has been noticed by the industry.

### A Todd Haynes Film He Believes Deserved More Recognition

During the interview, Nivola also spoke about a film directed by **Todd Haynes**. Haynes is a highly respected American filmmaker known for creating emotional and visually rich stories. Nivola said that this particular Haynes film could have earned his co-star **Michelle Williams** an Oscar nomination — but it did not.

Nivola did not hide his feelings about this. He clearly believed that Williams' performance in the film was exceptional and that it deserved greater recognition from the Academy Awards voters.

Michelle Williams is already a well-known actress with multiple Oscar nominations throughout her career. So for a co-star to say a specific performance was strong enough to win suggests it was truly memorable.

### Why This Matters

Alessandro Nivola is known for choosing interesting and challenging roles. His decision to play Calvin Klein — a real, well-known person — requires careful research and respect for the truth. Playing real people is always a difficult task for actors because audiences already have ideas about who that person was.

The interview shows that Nivola is thoughtful about his work and the work of those around him. Whether talking about his current TV role or reflecting on past film projects, he speaks with honesty and care.

## The Fall's Final Album Is Coming This Autumn

The English post-punk band The Fall will release their final album this autumn. The album is called *Post-Script*, and it will be a special moment for fans of the band around the world.

### Who Are The Fall?

The Fall was formed in Manchester, England in 1976. They are known as one of the most important and influential post-punk bands in music history. Post-punk is a style of rock music that developed after punk rock in the late 1970s. It is known for being experimental and unconventional.

The band's leader was **Mark E. Smith**, who was the singer and the driving creative force behind the group. Over the years, The Fall released more than 30 studio albums. Their music was known for its dark, repetitive style and Smith's unique spoken-word vocal delivery. Many musicians and critics consider The Fall to be one of the most original bands in British music history.

### Mark E. Smith's Death

Mark E. Smith passed away on **January 24, 2018**, after a long illness. He was 60 years old. His death was a huge loss for the music world. Without Smith, The Fall could not continue as a band.

However, before he died, Smith and the band had already begun working on new material. This unfinished work would eventually become *Post-Script*.

### About the Album

The title *Post-Script* is very meaningful. A "post-script" — often written as "P.S." — is a note added at the end of a letter, after the main message is finished. By choosing this title, the album seems to say: "Here is one last message from us."

The album represents the final recordings that The Fall made before Smith's death. It gives fans a chance to hear new music from the band one last time. For longtime listeners, this will likely be an emotional and important release.

### Why This Matters

It is not unusual for artists to release music after they have died. These are sometimes called "posthumous releases." Famous examples include albums by artists like Jimi Hendrix, Tupac Shakur, and Amy Winehouse. These releases can be complicated — some fans love hearing new material, while others feel it should remain private.

In the case of *Post-Script*, the fact that the band was actively working on the album before Smith's death makes it feel more intentional. It is not just leftover recordings — it was a project that Smith himself was involved in.

### Looking Forward

The exact release date has not been announced yet, but fans can expect the album sometime in **autumn 2026**. For followers of The Fall, this will be a final opportunity to experience new music from one of the UK's most unique and respected bands.
