## *Michael* Becomes the Biggest Music Biopic Ever

A new film called *Michael* has made history. It is now the **highest-grossing music biopic** of all time. This means it has earned more money than any other film about a musician's life.

### How Much Money Did It Make?

The film has earned **$911.9 million** worldwide. That is almost one billion dollars! This is a huge number, and it shows just how popular the film has been with audiences around the world.

### What Is a Biopic?

A "biopic" is a type of movie. It tells the true story of a real person's life. "Bio" comes from the word "biography," which means the story of someone's life. Many biopics are made about famous musicians, athletes, and leaders.

### What Is *Michael* About?

*Michael* is a film about the life of **Michael Jackson**, one of the most famous singers in the world. Michael Jackson was known as the "King of Pop." He sold hundreds of millions of records during his career. He was famous for his amazing dancing, his unique voice, and his iconic music videos.

Michael Jackson died on **June 25, 2009**, at the age of 50. Even today, he is one of the best-known and most-loved musicians in history.

### The Previous Record Holder

Before *Michael*, the highest-grossing music biopic was **Bohemian Rhapsody**. That film was released in **2018** and told the story of the rock band **Queen** and their lead singer, **Freddie Mercury**. Bohemian Rhapsody was very successful and won several awards, including the Academy Award for Best Film Editing.

Now, *Michael* has passed that record. It has earned more money than Bohemian Rhapsody at the global box office.

### Why Are Music Biopics So Popular?

Music biopics are very popular with cinema audiences. People enjoy learning about the lives of their favorite musicians. These films often include live music performances, which makes them exciting to watch on a big screen.

Some other well-known music biopics include:
- ***Rocketman*** (2019) — about the life of Elton John
- ***Elvis*** (2022) — about the life of Elvis Presley
- ***Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody*** (2022) — about Whitney Houston

Each of these films was a big success, but none of them earned as much money as *Michael* has now.

### A Big Moment for Cinema

The success of *Michael* shows that people around the world still love Michael Jackson's music and story. Earning nearly $912 million is a remarkable achievement for any film. It will be interesting to see if any future music biopic can break this record.

## Trump's Struggles with Iran — What It Means for Korea

The United States, under President Donald Trump, has faced a significant setback in its diplomatic efforts with Iran. After months of pressure and negotiations, the talks have not produced the results the Trump administration hoped for. This failure is being watched closely around the world — especially in South Korea.

**Why Does Iran Matter to Korea?**

At first, it may seem strange that events involving Iran would affect South Korea. However, the way the United States handles difficult countries like Iran sends a strong message to other nations — including North Korea.

If the US cannot pressure or negotiate successfully with Iran, it raises serious questions about how effective American diplomacy can be with North Korea. Both Iran and North Korea have nuclear programs that the US and its allies want to stop or limit.

**The Stakes Are Higher Now**

South Korea depends heavily on the US for its security. The two countries have a strong military alliance, and American troops are stationed in South Korea. For decades, the US has promised to protect South Korea from any threat from the North.

However, if the US appears weak or unable to win in difficult negotiations, it could give North Korea more confidence to push harder and make fewer compromises. North Korea may decide that America cannot be trusted to follow through on its promises or threats.

This is a worrying situation for Seoul. South Korea's government must think carefully about how to respond if US influence in the region begins to weaken.

**A Warning Sign for Korean Diplomacy**

Editorial writers and political analysts in South Korea are saying that Trump's difficulties in Iran should serve as a wake-up call. South Korea cannot simply rely on the US to solve all of its security problems.

Instead, South Korea may need to strengthen its own diplomatic efforts — perhaps talking more directly with neighboring countries like China and Japan, or even exploring new channels of communication with North Korea.

**Looking Ahead**

The situation is still developing. It is not yet clear exactly what Trump's Iran policy means for future US actions in Asia. But experts agree that the outcome of US-Iran relations will have ripple effects across the world.

For South Korea, the message is clear: the international environment is becoming more uncertain, and the country must be prepared to act more independently if necessary. The stakes — peace, security, and stability on the Korean Peninsula — could not be higher.

## Kim Yo-jong Criticizes G7 Over North Korea Denuclearization Demands

Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, has made strong public statements against the G7 group of nations. She accused them of "inviting disaster" by continuing to demand that North Korea give up its nuclear weapons.

**Who Is Kim Yo-jong?**

Kim Yo-jong is widely considered one of the most powerful people in North Korea. She is the younger sister of leader Kim Jong-un and often speaks on behalf of the North Korean government on important political issues. When she makes a statement, the world pays attention.

**What Did She Say?**

Kim Yo-jong released an official statement strongly criticizing the G7 — a group of seven of the world's largest economies, including the United States, Japan, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Italy.

The G7 had called on North Korea to abandon its nuclear weapons program as part of a broader commitment to global peace and security. This is not a new demand — Western nations have been asking North Korea to denuclearize for many years.

However, Kim Yo-jong rejected this demand completely. She said that the G7 was making a dangerous mistake and warned that their pressure would lead to serious consequences. She described the G7's position as "inviting disaster."

**Why Does North Korea Refuse?**

North Korea has long argued that its nuclear weapons are necessary for its own protection. The country's leadership believes that without nuclear weapons, North Korea could be attacked or forced to change its political system — something they are determined to prevent.

From Pyongyang's point of view, giving up nuclear weapons would leave the country vulnerable. North Korea often points to examples of other countries, like Libya, that gave up weapons programs and later faced military intervention.

**International Reactions**

The statement from Kim Yo-jong is likely to increase tensions between North Korea and Western nations. It makes it clear that North Korea has no intention of returning to denuclearization talks under current conditions.

For South Korea and Japan — both close to North Korea geographically — this kind of statement is deeply concerning. It suggests that diplomatic progress on the nuclear issue remains very far away.

**The Bigger Picture**

The exchange between the G7 and Kim Yo-jong reflects a long-standing and deeply difficult international problem. Despite years of negotiations, sanctions, and diplomatic pressure, North Korea has continued to develop and test its nuclear weapons.

As long as both sides remain far apart in their positions, finding a peaceful solution will be extremely challenging. For now, Kim Yo-jong's sharp words serve as a reminder that the Korean Peninsula remains one of the most tense places in the world.

## Tesla Autopilot Crash Kills Woman in Texas

A Tesla driver in Harris County, Texas, crashed into a house and killed a woman while using the car's Autopilot system. Officials confirmed the accident on June 21, 2026. The driver told investigators that he had turned on the vehicle's automated driving system before the crash happened.

### What Happened?

According to investigators, the Tesla left the road and drove directly into a residential home. A woman inside the house was killed as a result. Authorities are now looking into what caused the vehicle to leave the roadway.

The driver said he was relying on Tesla's Autopilot feature at the time of the accident. Autopilot is a driver-assistance system that can control a car's speed and steering under certain conditions. However, Tesla and other car companies warn that drivers must always pay attention and keep their hands on the wheel, even when Autopilot is turned on.

### What Is Tesla Autopilot?

Tesla's Autopilot is not a fully self-driving system. It is designed to help drivers, not to replace them. The system can handle tasks like staying in a lane, adjusting speed, and braking. But it cannot handle every road situation, and it requires a human driver to stay alert at all times.

Over the years, there have been several serious accidents involving Tesla's Autopilot. Some of these crashes have led to investigations by U.S. safety regulators, including the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). The agency has looked into whether the technology is safe enough for public roads.

### Growing Concerns About Automated Driving

This latest crash raises fresh questions about the safety of automated driving systems. As more car companies develop and sell these technologies, governments and safety groups are debating how they should be regulated.

Critics argue that some drivers trust Autopilot too much. They may stop paying attention to the road because they believe the car can handle everything. Experts call this problem "automation complacency" — when people become too relaxed because a machine is doing the work.

Supporters of the technology, on the other hand, say that automated systems can actually reduce accidents overall. They point out that human error causes the majority of traffic accidents every year. They believe that, with better technology and clearer rules, automated driving could make roads safer in the long run.

### What Happens Next?

Local authorities and possibly federal safety regulators will investigate this crash. They will examine the car's data, the road conditions, and the driver's actions to understand exactly what went wrong.

The case is likely to add pressure on Tesla and regulators to review the standards for automated driving systems. It also serves as a reminder that current driver-assistance technology still requires full human attention behind the wheel.

## Middle East Oil Recovery Faces Major Obstacles

More oil is once again flowing out of the Persian Gulf, but the road to a full recovery remains uncertain. Producers in the region are cautiously increasing output, while simultaneously searching for safer and more reliable ways to move their oil to global markets.

### The Current Situation

After a period of disruption, Middle Eastern oil producers are beginning to ramp up exports through the Persian Gulf. This is positive news for global energy markets, which have been watching the region closely. However, serious challenges remain that could slow or reverse this progress.

Three key threats are standing in the way of a smooth oil rebound: naval mines, logistical difficulties, and deep uncertainty about regional security.

### The Threat of Mines

One of the most immediate dangers is the presence of naval mines in and around the Persian Gulf. Mines are explosive devices placed underwater that can destroy ships. Even a single confirmed mine incident can cause shipping companies to avoid an entire route, dramatically disrupting the flow of oil.

The threat of mines forces tanker operators and insurance companies to think carefully before sending ships through the area. Higher insurance costs and the risk of delays make it more expensive and complicated to export oil from the region.

### Logistics and Alternative Routes

Beyond the physical danger of mines, producers are also dealing with significant logistical challenges. Moving large amounts of oil requires functioning ports, available tankers, and smooth coordination across borders.

In response to these risks, some producers are actively developing alternative export routes that bypass the most dangerous parts of the Persian Gulf. For example, pipelines that cross overland to other coastlines can reduce dependence on sea routes that pass through conflict-prone areas.

However, building or expanding these alternative routes takes time, money, and political cooperation — none of which are easy to secure in an unstable region.

### Deep Uncertainty in the Region

Perhaps the biggest challenge of all is the broader sense of uncertainty hanging over the Middle East. Political tensions, the risk of military conflict, and unpredictable policy decisions make it difficult for energy companies and governments to plan with confidence.

Oil markets are particularly sensitive to uncertainty. Even the possibility of disruption can cause oil prices to rise sharply, affecting economies around the world. Producers want to increase output and revenue, but they are reluctant to make large investments if the security situation could change at any moment.

### Why This Matters Globally

The Middle East is one of the world's most important oil-producing regions. Countries like Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Iraq, and Kuwait together supply a significant share of global energy. Any sustained disruption to oil exports from this region can push up fuel prices worldwide and slow economic growth.

As the region tries to stabilize and boost production, both energy companies and governments around the world will be closely monitoring the situation — hoping for a smooth recovery, but preparing for continued volatility.

## Bose Wants to Be a Media Company — But Can It Succeed?

Bose is a well-known audio technology company. It makes headphones, speakers, and other sound equipment. Most people know Bose for its high-quality products. But now, the company wants to do something very different — it wants to become a media company.

### What Is Bose Doing?

Bose has announced the creation of **Bose Studios**, a new part of the company focused on media and content. One of the most surprising parts of Bose Studios is **Bose Records**, a new music record label.

Bose's Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), Jim Mollica, spoke about this plan in an interview with *Business Insider*. He said Bose wants to move away from "campaign-driven marketing." This means Bose no longer wants to rely only on traditional advertisements to reach customers. Instead, it wants to create content — like music — that connects with people in a deeper way.

### The Red Bull Example

Bose seems to be inspired by **Red Bull**, the energy drink company. Red Bull is famous for successfully becoming a media brand. It produces extreme sports videos, music events, and even has its own record label called Red Bull Records. Many people engage with Red Bull's content without even thinking about the drink itself.

Bose appears to want the same kind of success. The company already has a strong connection to music and sound, so entering the music industry might seem like a natural step.

### The Problem: Many Companies Have Tried and Failed

However, this is not a new idea — and it usually does not work. Many companies outside the music industry have tried to start record labels or media divisions. Most of them have failed. The music industry is very competitive, and it takes more than money to succeed. You need deep knowledge of music, strong relationships with artists, and an understanding of what listeners want.

Some critics point out that Bose, while connected to audio technology, is still a product company at its core. Making good speakers is very different from discovering talent, producing hit songs, or running a successful label.

The article from *The Verge* notes that Bose has "more of a right" to enter the media world than some other companies — for example, Build-a-Bear, the toy store chain, would make even less sense as a record label. But having some connection to music does not guarantee success.

### Will It Work?

It is too early to say whether Bose Studios and Bose Records will succeed. The idea of a brand becoming a media company is exciting, but the history of similar projects is not encouraging. Red Bull is often held up as the great success story, but for every Red Bull, there are many forgotten corporate labels that quietly disappeared.

Bose is a respected brand with loyal customers. If it can use that trust and its deep connection to sound and music culture, it might have a chance. But it will need more than a good idea — it will need great music, talented artists, and a clear strategy.

For now, the music world is watching to see if Bose can truly reinvent itself — or if Bose Records will become just another name in the long list of failed corporate music experiments.

## Trump Administration Funds Coal Plant Despite Repeated Violations

A coal-fired power plant in Tennessee that was scheduled to close is now receiving millions of dollars in federal funding to keep operating. Critics say this decision ignores years of pollution violations and public health concerns.

### Background: The Cumberland Fossil Plant

The **Cumberland Fossil Plant**, located in Tennessee, has a long history of environmental problems. It is operated by the **Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA)**, a federally owned corporation that provides electricity to millions of people in the southeastern United States.

The plant has faced serious issues for years:
- It was part of a **multibillion-dollar legal settlement in 2011** after TVA failed to install required pollution control technology more than a decade earlier.
- Regulators cited the plant for **air-pollution violations in both 2017 and 2023**.
- Community members and health advocates raised ongoing concerns about the plant's impact on air quality and public health.

Because of these problems, TVA announced plans to **shut down Cumberland's units in 2026 and 2028**. The closure was seen as an important step toward cleaner energy and improved air quality in the region.

### The Trump Administration Steps In

However, that plan has now been reversed. The **Trump administration replaced four of TVA's board members**, giving the federal government more influence over the agency's decisions. Shortly after these changes, TVA **abandoned its retirement plan for Cumberland** in February.

Now, the plant has received a **federal pledge of $46 million** to extend its operational lifespan. This funding is part of a broader national policy pushed by **President Donald Trump** to keep older coal plants running across the country.

The Trump administration argues that maintaining coal plants is important for **energy security** — ensuring that the country has a stable and reliable supply of electricity. Supporters of the policy say that closing too many power plants too quickly could lead to electricity shortages, particularly during periods of high demand.

### Critics Raise Concerns

Environmentalists and public health experts strongly oppose the decision. They argue that investing in a plant with **repeated violations** sends the wrong message and puts local communities at risk.

The Cumberland plant's troubled history makes it a particularly controversial choice for federal investment. A plant that was already under legal and regulatory pressure for failing to meet pollution standards is now being given public money to continue operating.

Critics also point out that the decision contradicts years of environmental policy and legal agreements. The 2011 settlement was the result of TVA breaking the law by not installing proper pollution controls. Funding the plant now, they argue, rewards past failures rather than encouraging cleaner alternatives.

### A Wider Pattern

Cumberland is not an isolated case. The Trump administration has made **supporting the coal industry** a key part of its energy policy. This includes rolling back environmental regulations, reducing oversight of pollution, and encouraging utilities to keep coal plants open rather than transitioning to natural gas or renewable energy sources.

This approach represents a significant shift from previous administrations, which had been gradually moving the country toward cleaner energy. The debate over Cumberland reflects a larger national argument about the balance between **economic interests, energy reliability, and environmental responsibility**.

For residents living near the Cumberland Fossil Plant, the question is not abstract — it is about the air they breathe every day.

## Olivia Rodrigo Gets Her Third No. 1 Album

Olivia Rodrigo is on a historic run. Her new album, *You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love*, has debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart. This makes it her **third consecutive No. 1 album** — meaning every album she has released has gone straight to the top of the chart.

### A Record-Breaking First Week

The album was released on June 12, 2026. In its first week, it earned **485,000 equivalent album units**. This is the biggest first-week number of her entire career. It is also the biggest first-week total for any artist so far in 2026.

The Billboard 200 is the most important albums chart in the United States. It measures how popular an album is by counting streams, digital downloads, and physical sales together. When these numbers are combined, they are called "equivalent album units."

### Rodrigo's Rapid Rise

Olivia Rodrigo first became famous in 2021 with her debut album *Sour*, which included the massive hit "drivers license." That album also debuted at No. 1. Her second album, *Guts*, released in 2023, repeated that success by also reaching the top spot.

Now, with her third album, she has proven that her popularity is not slowing down. In fact, it is growing. Each of her albums has performed better than the last, which is very unusual in the music industry.

### Why This Matters

Reaching No. 1 three times in a row is a rare achievement. Very few artists in music history have started their careers with three straight No. 1 albums. This puts Rodrigo in the company of some of the biggest names in pop music.

Fans and music journalists are calling this result a sign that Rodrigo has become one of the most important artists of her generation. At only in her early twenties, she has already built an impressive legacy in the music world.

With strong streaming numbers and devoted fans around the world, it seems likely that *You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love* will remain at or near the top of the charts for several weeks to come.

## 'Criminal Minds' Star Sparks Controversy After Attacking TV Critic Online

Actress Paget Brewster, known for her long-running role in the TV series *Criminal Minds*, has found herself at the center of a public controversy after she responded aggressively to a journalist who wrote a mixed review of the show.

### What Happened?

On a Saturday afternoon, Brewster posted a message on X (formerly Twitter) directed at Shealyn Scott, a writer for the entertainment website ScreenRant. Scott had written an article expressing disappointment about changes that the streaming platform Paramount+ had made to *Criminal Minds*, which is a long-running procedural crime drama.

In her post, Brewster addressed the critic directly by name. "Hello critic Shealynn Scott," she wrote. "You're young. You don't know that bad pics and bad reviews can lead to..." The post then continued with further remarks, including a suggestion that Scott should "work at a shelter" instead of writing reviews.

Brewster later deleted the post, but not before it had been widely seen and shared online.

### Strong Reactions From the Media Community

The response from journalists and critics was swift and largely negative. Many media professionals argued that it is inappropriate — and potentially harmful — for actors to publicly attack critics for giving honest reviews. Freedom of the press and the right to critique public entertainment are considered important professional values in journalism.

Several critics pointed out that negative or mixed reviews are a normal part of working in the entertainment industry. Attempting to intimidate or silence a reviewer, especially a younger one, was seen by many as a serious overstep.

### A Broader Debate

The incident has reignited a wider debate about how public figures should behave on social media. Celebrities have large audiences and significant influence, which means their words — even in a deleted post — can cause real damage to a person's reputation or career.

Some supporters of Brewster argued that she was simply defending her show and her colleagues. However, critics of her behavior noted that there is a clear difference between defending one's work and personally attacking a journalist for doing their job.

### The Show Itself

*Criminal Minds* originally aired on CBS from 2005 to 2020 before being revived by Paramount+. The Paramount+ version has made several changes to the format and cast, which some longtime fans and reviewers have found disappointing. It is this context that led to Scott's original article and, ultimately, to Brewster's controversial response.

## SZA and Kenneth Blume Speak Out Against AI Training Using Their Music

Renowned R&B artist SZA and songwriter Kenneth Blume have publicly criticized the use of their songs in artificial intelligence (AI) training datasets. Their statements have reignited an ongoing debate about the rights of musicians in the age of AI technology.

### What Is an AI Training Dataset?

AI music tools are trained by processing large amounts of existing music. By analyzing thousands of songs, an AI system learns patterns in melody, rhythm, lyrics, and style. It can then generate new music that mimics these patterns. The problem, according to many artists, is that this process often uses copyrighted songs **without the permission of the original creators** and without any financial compensation.

### What Did SZA and Kenneth Blume Say?

Kenneth Blume expressed his frustration in strong terms, stating: **"I can't imagine being proud to earn a paycheck obliterating the work and dreams of artists."** This comment was directed at those who build and profit from AI systems trained on artists' work without consent.

SZA also voiced her disapproval, adding her name to a growing list of high-profile musicians who are pushing back against the practice. SZA is one of the most successful artists in contemporary R&B and pop music, known for albums like *Ctrl* and *SOS*.

### A Growing Movement

SZA and Blume are not alone. Many well-known musicians and songwriters have recently spoken out about AI companies using their music without authorization. Some artists have signed open letters demanding stronger legal protections, while others have taken legal action.

The music industry as a whole is grappling with how to respond to rapid advances in AI. Record labels, streaming platforms, and individual artists are all trying to determine what rules should govern the use of copyrighted music in AI development.

### Why Does It Matter?

For artists, their music represents years of creative effort, personal expression, and financial investment. When AI systems are trained on that music without permission, it raises serious ethical and legal questions:

- Should artists be paid when their work is used to train AI?
- Do current copyright laws adequately protect musicians from this type of use?
- Who is responsible — the AI developers, the companies that deploy the tools, or both?

### The Bigger Picture

This issue extends beyond music. Writers, visual artists, and filmmakers have raised similar concerns about their work being used without consent to train AI systems. Courts in several countries are currently hearing cases related to AI and intellectual property.

As AI-generated content becomes more common, the conversation about fair compensation and creative rights is only expected to grow louder.

## Decoding the 'Hefei Model': How One Chinese City Became a Tech Powerhouse

Hefei is the capital city of Anhui Province in eastern China. Not long ago, it was considered one of China's less developed cities. Today, however, Hefei is recognized as one of the country's most impressive examples of economic and technological transformation. Experts often call its approach the "Hefei model."

### What Is the Hefei Model?

The Hefei model refers to a strategy that the city used to grow its economy and become a leader in advanced technology industries. Analysts describe it as resting on four main pillars, or key ideas. Together, these pillars helped Hefei attract major companies, develop local talent, and build a strong innovation ecosystem.

### Pillar One: Government-Led Investment

One of the most important parts of the Hefei model is the active role of the local government. Instead of simply waiting for private businesses to invest, the Hefei government directly put public money into promising companies and industries. This approach is sometimes called "state venture capital." The government took calculated risks by investing early in sectors like semiconductors, electric vehicles, and display technology. When these bets paid off, the profits were reinvested into new projects.

### Pillar Two: Attracting Key Industries

Hefei worked hard to bring major corporations to the city. A famous example is the government's decision to invest heavily in BOE Technology, a leading display screen manufacturer, and later in NIO, a well-known electric vehicle company. By offering financial support and favorable conditions, Hefei persuaded these large firms to set up operations locally. This created jobs and helped build a network of smaller supplier companies around them.

### Pillar Three: Nurturing Local Talent

A city cannot grow its tech sector without skilled workers. Hefei is home to the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), one of the country's top research universities. The city worked closely with universities and research institutes to keep talented graduates local, offering incentives for them to start businesses or join tech firms in Hefei rather than moving to bigger cities like Beijing or Shanghai.

### Pillar Four: Building an Innovation Ecosystem

The fourth pillar involves creating an environment where new ideas can grow. Hefei established special technology zones and industrial parks where startups and research centers could work side by side with larger companies. The government also streamlined bureaucratic processes, making it easier for businesses to operate. Over time, this created a self-reinforcing cycle: success attracted more investment, which led to more success.

### Why Does the Hefei Model Matter?

The Hefei model is being closely studied both inside and outside China. As global competition in advanced technology — especially semiconductors and electric vehicles — intensifies, many observers want to understand how a mid-sized Chinese city managed to climb to the top so quickly.

For countries like South Korea, which also compete in these high-tech industries, understanding the Hefei model is increasingly important. It shows how a combination of strategic government investment, industrial policy, education, and long-term planning can dramatically change a region's economic fate.

Hefei's rise is not without criticism. Some economists question whether government-led investment models are sustainable or efficient in the long run. Nevertheless, the results so far have been difficult to ignore, and Hefei continues to grow as a symbol of China's broader technological ambitions.

## Korea and the US Join Forces to Boost Shipbuilding Investment

South Korea and the United States have signed a new financing agreement aimed at increasing Korean investment in the American shipbuilding industry. This deal reflects a growing partnership between the two countries in a sector that is strategically important for both economic and national security reasons.

### Why Shipbuilding Matters

Shipbuilding is the industry that designs and builds large vessels such as cargo ships, oil tankers, and naval warships. For decades, the United States had one of the world's strongest shipbuilding industries. However, over time, American shipbuilding declined significantly, while countries like South Korea, China, and Japan took the lead.

Today, South Korea is one of the world's top shipbuilders. Companies like HD Hyundai, Samsung Heavy Industries, and Hanwha Ocean are known for producing high-quality ships efficiently. The US, on the other hand, has been trying to rebuild its shipbuilding capacity, especially for military and commercial purposes.

### What the New Agreement Does

The new financing pact is designed to make it easier for Korean companies to invest money in American shipyards and related industries. A financing pact is an agreement about how money will be provided, managed, and guaranteed between parties.

Under this kind of agreement, financial institutions from both countries can work together to fund large projects. This lowers the financial risk for Korean companies thinking about building facilities or forming partnerships in the United States. It also helps American shipyards access Korean expertise and capital.

### Why Korea Is Interested

For South Korea, investing in the US shipbuilding sector offers several advantages. First, it helps Korean companies secure business in one of the world's largest markets. Second, it strengthens the political and economic relationship between Seoul and Washington at a time when global trade tensions are high.

Additionally, with the US government actively encouraging domestic manufacturing through various policy programs, Korean firms see an opportunity to participate in a growing market with government support behind it.

### Why the US Wants Korean Involvement

The United States has made rebuilding its shipbuilding industry a priority. American officials have expressed concern that the country relies too heavily on foreign-built ships, which could be a problem in times of conflict or supply chain disruption.

South Korea's advanced technology and experienced workforce make it an ideal partner. Rather than starting from scratch, the US can benefit from Korean know-how while also creating jobs on American soil. The new financing agreement is one practical step toward making this cooperation happen more quickly.

### A Broader Trend

This deal is part of a broader trend of South Korea positioning itself as a key partner for the United States in important industries. Similar cooperation is happening in areas like semiconductors, batteries for electric vehicles, and defense equipment.

For South Korea, these partnerships are both economically valuable and diplomatically important. They help Korea maintain a strong alliance with the US while also finding new opportunities for its world-class industries to grow.

As both countries move forward with this agreement, observers will be watching to see how quickly Korean investment flows into American shipyards and whether the partnership leads to a genuine revival of US shipbuilding capacity.

## 'Supergirl' Has a Disappointing Opening Weekend

The new DC Studios film *Supergirl* did not perform as well as expected at the box office this weekend. The movie earned an estimated **$38 million** in its opening weekend, finishing in second place. For a big-budget superhero film, this was considered a disappointing result.

### What Is DC Studios Trying to Do?

DC Studios is the company behind famous superhero characters like Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman. In recent years, DC has been trying to **reboot** — or completely restart — its series of superhero movies. This means they are building a brand new story universe from the beginning, similar to what Marvel Studios did successfully many years ago.

A reboot is a risky strategy. It requires a lot of money to produce new films, and the studio needs audiences to be excited about new versions of familiar characters. The weak opening of *Supergirl* suggests that DC Studios may be facing some challenges in winning over moviegoers.

### How Did the Rest of the Box Office Do?

Interestingly, the overall box office results for the weekend were actually quite positive. Total ticket sales across all movies were **up 21 percent** compared to the same weekend last year. This means that people are going to the cinema more than they were a year ago — good news for the movie industry in general.

However, *Supergirl* still underperformed. When a movie costs hundreds of millions of dollars to make and market, studios typically hope for a much stronger opening weekend. Coming in second place with $38 million raises questions about whether audiences are fully embracing DC's new direction.

### Why Does the Opening Weekend Matter So Much?

In the film industry, the **opening weekend** is extremely important. It gives studios, investors, and analysts a first look at how popular a movie is. A strong opening usually means the film will be profitable. A weak opening can make it harder for the movie to earn back its costs, even if it performs steadily in later weeks.

Word of mouth — what people say to their friends and family after seeing a film — also plays a big role. If early audiences love a movie, more people will go see it in the following weeks. If they are not impressed, ticket sales tend to fall quickly.

### What Happens Next for DC Studios?

DC Studios has several more films and television projects planned as part of its reboot. The performance of *Supergirl* will likely influence decisions about budgets, marketing, and future projects. Studio executives will be watching future weekends closely to see if the film can recover.

For now, the disappointing debut of *Supergirl* is a reminder that even well-known superhero brands are not guaranteed to succeed at the box office. Building a successful franchise takes time, consistency, and stories that connect with audiences.

33efbb5242cb.learnerContent:
## Can Advertisers Reach Consumers Through A.I.?

For decades, advertisers have been experts at grabbing **human attention**. They use eye-catching visuals, emotional storytelling, and clever slogans to make people notice — and remember — their brands. But a new challenge has arrived: what happens when consumers stop searching for information themselves and instead ask an **A.I. chatbot** to do it for them?

This question was at the heart of discussions at **Cannes Lions**, one of the most important advertising festivals in the world, held annually in the south of France. This year, marketers and brand strategists gathered to grapple with how artificial intelligence is changing the rules of their industry.

### The Rise of A.I. as a Information Gatekeeper

Millions of people now use A.I. chatbots — such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, or Apple Intelligence — to get recommendations, compare products, and make purchasing decisions. Instead of clicking through search results and seeing banner advertisements, users simply ask a question and receive a direct, summarised answer.

This shift presents a serious problem for advertisers. Traditional digital advertising works by placing ads in front of people while they browse the internet or use apps. But when an A.I. model generates an answer, it typically does not include paid advertisements. The chatbot simply recommends what it considers the best option — based on the data it was trained on.

### How Can Brands Influence A.I. Recommendations?

At Cannes Lions, marketers debated several possible strategies. One key idea is **"A.I. optimisation"** — similar to search engine optimisation (SEO), which helped brands appear at the top of Google results. The goal would be to ensure that a brand's products, values, and reputation are well represented in the data that A.I. systems learn from.

This might mean producing more high-quality online content, earning positive reviews on trusted websites, and building a strong, credible presence across the internet. The logic is that if an A.I. model has absorbed a lot of reliable, positive information about a brand, it may be more likely to recommend it.

However, this approach is far from straightforward. Unlike search engines, the inner workings of large A.I. language models are not fully transparent, making it difficult to know exactly what influences their outputs.

### A Fundamental Shift in Marketing

Some industry experts at Cannes Lions argued that the rise of A.I. represents the most significant transformation in advertising since the emergence of the internet. When consumers delegate their decision-making to an algorithm, the traditional relationship between brand and buyer is disrupted.

Adversiting has always been about persuasion — convincing a human being that a product is worth their time and money. But A.I. systems are not influenced by emotion, attractive packaging, or a catchy jingle. They process information and generate responses based on patterns in data.

### What Comes Next?

The advertising industry does not yet have clear answers. Marketers are experimenting, collaborating with technology companies, and closely watching how consumer behaviour continues to evolve. What is clear is that brands can no longer rely solely on the strategies that worked in the past.

In an age where A.I. acts as an intermediary between brands and consumers, standing out will require a fundamentally different approach — one that is still being written.

## China's AI Catches Up in Cybersecurity

A Chinese artificial intelligence company called Zhipu AI — also known as Z.ai — has released a new AI model called GLM-5.2. This is an "open-weight" model, meaning that its internal settings are shared publicly so that other researchers and developers can study and use it.

### Matching US Models in Cybersecurity

Some researchers who tested GLM-5.2 say it performs just as well as one of America's most advanced AI models, called Mythos, in certain cybersecurity tasks. Cybersecurity involves finding and fixing weaknesses in computer systems. When AI models can find "bugs" — errors or security holes in software — they become very powerful tools for both defense and attack.

However, GLM-5.2 does not beat US models in every area. In more general tasks, it still falls behind models made by American companies like Anthropic and OpenAI. But the progress in cybersecurity is still seen as a very important development.

### The Gap Is Getting Smaller

Just a few years ago, Chinese AI models were considered much weaker than US ones. Now, experts say China has "dramatically reduced the gap" — meaning the difference in quality between Chinese and American AI is much smaller than before. This is a significant change in the global AI race.

### Why the US Government Is Worried

This development is causing concern in Washington. The US government has been trying to slow down China's progress in AI. One way it does this is by restricting, or limiting, China's access to powerful AI models like Mythos and Fable, both made by Anthropic. The US has also tried to stop China from getting the special computer chips needed to train and run powerful AI systems.

The Trump administration considers advanced AI models to be important national security tools. If China can develop its own models that match American ones — especially in sensitive areas like cybersecurity — then US restrictions become less effective.

### What This Means for the Future

The release of GLM-5.2 shows that even with export restrictions and limited access to hardware, Chinese AI companies are continuing to make fast progress. Cybersecurity is a critical area because governments, banks, hospitals, and businesses all depend on secure computer systems.

If AI can be used to find and exploit weaknesses in those systems, then the country with the most advanced cybersecurity AI could have a major advantage. The fact that China may now be at a similar level to the US in this specific area is seen as a serious development by many security experts and government officials.

The global competition in AI technology is clearly accelerating, and the release of GLM-5.2 is one more sign that this race is far from over.

2c67b4d622a5.learnerContent:
## Suno Launches 'Spark' Program for Independent Artists

Suno, a company known for its AI music generation tool, has announced a new program called **Spark**. This is an incubator program designed to support independent musicians. An incubator program helps new or small artists grow by giving them resources and guidance.

### What Is Suno?

Suno is a platform that uses artificial intelligence to create music. Users can type a description — for example, "a sad piano song about missing home" — and the AI will generate a complete song. The company has been popular as a fun creative tool, but it has also been criticized for making it too easy to produce low-quality, unoriginal music at a large scale.

Now, Suno wants to be seen as more than just a tool for generating quick, throwaway songs. The company hopes to become a proper streaming destination — a place where people go to discover and listen to music — and to help launch the careers of new artists.

### What Does the Spark Program Offer?

Through the Spark program, Suno will offer selected independent artists three types of support:

- **Grants** — money given to artists to help fund their music projects
- **Mentorship** — guidance from experienced people in the music industry
- **Marketing support** — help promoting their music to reach more listeners

To be eligible to apply, artists must be unsigned — meaning they do not have a contract with a major record label. They must also be a singer, songwriter, or music producer who releases music under their own name.

### The Controversial Terms and Conditions

However, not everyone is happy about the Spark program. On Reddit's Suno community page, some users have raised concerns about the terms and conditions that artists must agree to when they apply.

One requirement is that artists must make their songs available on the Suno platform for **remixing**. This means other users — or Suno's AI — could take an artist's song and create new versions of it. On its own, this might not seem too alarming. Many music platforms already allow remixing in some form.

But the bigger concern is the **broad license** that artists must give to Suno. A license is a legal agreement that gives a company certain rights to use your work. Critics say the license Suno requires is too wide — it may give Suno significant control over how an artist's music is used, potentially including using songs to train its AI system.

### Why This Matters

The music industry has been watching AI companies very carefully. Many artists and record labels are worried about AI using human-made music without fair payment or permission. If Suno's Spark program requires artists to give up broad rights to their music in exchange for support, some believe this could be harmful to the very artists the program claims to help.

Whether the Spark program will attract independent musicians — or push them away — remains to be seen. Artists considering applying are encouraged to read the terms carefully before signing.

## Stephen Poliakoff Returns to TV With Epic Historical Thriller 'The Order'

British writer Stephen Poliakoff is coming back to major television with a brand new drama series called **"The Order."** The show is an international political thriller set in one of the most dramatic moments in European history.

### Who Is Stephen Poliakoff?

Stephen Poliakoff is a highly respected British writer and filmmaker. He has won multiple BAFTA awards — the U.K.'s most important film and television prizes — as well as Emmy Awards, which are given for outstanding American television. He is well known for creating rich, detailed dramas that explore history and politics.

After some years away from large-scale TV productions, his return has created a lot of excitement in the television world.

### What Is 'The Order' About?

"The Order" is set during the **Great Siege of Malta in 1565**, one of the most famous battles in history. During this siege, the Ottoman Empire — one of the most powerful forces in the world at that time — attacked the small island of Malta. The Knights of St. John, a military and religious group, defended the island in a dramatic and bloody battle that lasted for months.

The story covers the months **leading up to and during** this famous siege. It is described as a political thriller, which means it will likely focus not only on battles, but also on the secret deals, power struggles, and dangerous decisions made by leaders and soldiers during this tense period.

The series will have **eight episodes**, giving the story plenty of time to develop its characters and historical setting.

### Where Was It Announced?

The series was officially announced by **Johann Grech**, the Malta Film Commissioner, at the **Mediterrane** film event. Malta, the small island nation in the Mediterranean Sea, is naturally a key location for the story. The island takes great pride in its history, and the Great Siege of 1565 is one of its most important historical events.

Filming in or around Malta would give the series an authentic look and feel, connecting modern audiences to this remarkable piece of history.

### Why Does This Matter?

Historical political thrillers are very popular with TV audiences around the world. Shows that combine real history with dramatic storytelling — such as power, loyalty, betrayal, and survival — tend to attract large, international audiences.

With a celebrated writer like Poliakoff leading the project, and such a compelling historical event at its center, "The Order" is already one of the most anticipated new TV series. Fans of historical drama and political thrillers will certainly be watching closely as more details are announced.

No release date has been confirmed yet, but the announcement alone has generated significant buzz in the entertainment industry.

39e2c12b94dd.learnerContent:
## U.K. Film Ratings Body Uses AI to Classify HBO Max's Entire Library

The **British Board of Film Classification (BBFC)**, the organization responsible for giving age ratings to films and TV shows in the United Kingdom, has used **artificial intelligence (AI)** for the first time to help classify content. The AI tool was specifically developed to rate HBO Max's entire catalogue of films and TV series ahead of the streaming platform's U.K. launch earlier in 2025.

### What Does the BBFC Do?

The BBFC is the U.K.'s main body for classifying films, TV shows, and online video content. It assigns age ratings — such as U (Universal), PG (Parental Guidance), 12, 15, and 18 — to help audiences, and especially parents, understand what content is appropriate for different age groups.

Traditionally, trained human examiners watch content and make classification decisions based on factors such as language, violence, sexual content, and drug use. This process is thorough, but it can be very time-consuming, especially when a large volume of content needs to be reviewed quickly.

### Why Was AI Needed?

When HBO Max prepared to launch in the United Kingdom, it brought with it an **enormous library** of content — hundreds or possibly thousands of films and TV programmes that all required official age ratings before they could be made available to U.K. subscribers.

Reviewing such a vast catalogue using only human examiners would have taken a very long time. To meet the deadline for the platform's launch, the BBFC developed a **bespoke AI tool** — meaning a custom-built system designed specifically for this purpose — to assist in the classification process.

### How Did the AI Tool Work?

According to the BBFC's **annual report for 2025**, the AI tool was used to **support** human decision-making rather than replace it entirely. The tool was designed to analyse content and provide recommendations, which human examiners could then review and confirm.

This kind of approach — where AI handles initial analysis and humans make final decisions — is increasingly common in industries that deal with large amounts of data. It allows organizations to work much more efficiently without sacrificing accuracy or responsibility.

### What Are the Wider Implications?

This development marks a significant moment for the BBFC and potentially for content regulation more broadly. As streaming services continue to grow and release more content than ever before, traditional classification methods may struggle to keep up.

However, the use of AI in sensitive areas like content classification also raises important questions. Critics may ask whether AI systems can truly understand context, cultural nuance, and the subtle reasons why certain content may be harmful to specific audiences. Ensuring that AI tools are **transparent, fair, and accountable** will be essential as their role in content regulation expands.

The BBFC's decision to disclose this development in its annual report suggests a commitment to **openness** about how new technologies are being used in the classification process. It will be interesting to see whether other national ratings bodies follow a similar path in the coming years.

## Future Reveals New Album: *The Real Me*

American rapper Future has announced a brand new album. The album is called **The Real Me**. He also shared the first single from the album at the same time.

### Spotify's Secret Teaser

For about one week before the announcement, the music streaming service Spotify had been teasing something big. Spotify showed mysterious hints to listeners, but did not say exactly what was coming. Now fans know the answer — it was Future's new album all along.

### Who Is Future?

Future is a very popular rapper from Atlanta, Georgia, in the United States. His real name is Nayvadius DeMun Wilburn. He has been making music since around 2010. He is known for his unique singing and rapping style, which mixes melodies with rap. Some of his well-known past albums include *DS2*, *HNDRXX*, and *I Never Liked You*.

Future often works with other big artists. He has made songs with Drake, Kendrick Lamar, and many others. He is one of the most successful rappers in the world today.

## Carly Rae Jepsen Returns with New Song *On Wires*

Canadian pop singer Carly Rae Jepsen has released a new song called **"On Wires."** The track serves as the lead single from her upcoming double album, which will include a total of **24 songs**.

### What Is the Song About?

"On Wires" explores the theme of wanting a romantic relationship with someone. The title and lyrics suggest a feeling of being emotionally connected to another person — like two hearts linked by invisible wires — while hoping that friendship can grow into something more. It is a relatable feeling that many people have experienced.

### The Sound of the Song

Musically, "On Wires" has been described as **pop-rock**. This means it combines the catchy, feel-good style of pop music with the louder, guitar-driven energy of rock. This blend gives the song an upbeat and exciting sound. Carly Rae Jepsen has always been known for making music that feels both emotional and fun, and this new single continues that tradition.

### A Double Album with 24 Tracks

One of the most exciting pieces of news is the size of the project. Jepsen's new release will be a **double album**, which means it is made up of two separate albums released together as one package. With 24 tracks in total, this will be one of the biggest projects of her career.

Double albums are not very common in modern music. Most artists release albums with around 10 to 15 songs. By releasing 24 tracks, Jepsen is giving her fans a large amount of new music to enjoy and explore.

### Who Is Carly Rae Jepsen?

Carly Rae Jepsen is a singer and songwriter from Mission, British Columbia, Canada. She first became internationally famous in 2012 with her hit song **"Call Me Maybe,"** which became one of the best-selling singles of that year.

Since then, she has built a strong and loyal fanbase with albums like *Emotion* (2015) and *Dedicated* (2019). Music critics often praise her for writing clever, heartfelt pop songs. She is especially popular among fans who love well-crafted, sincere pop music.

### Why Fans Are Excited

The release of "On Wires" has created a lot of buzz among Jepsen's dedicated fans, who often call themselves **"Emotion stans."** The promise of a 24-track double album means there will be plenty of new material to listen to, discuss, and enjoy.

With its pop-rock sound and romantic theme, "On Wires" seems like a strong start to what could be one of the most ambitious albums of Jepsen's career. Fans are eagerly waiting to hear the rest of the project.
